papers.abstract: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.

analysis.key_results: 在相同 LDPC 和 QAM 设置下，SemQAM-C 在 LPIPS 和 DISTS 上优于 OneDC 且复杂度更低；与分离方案相比，SemQAM 在相同 LPIPS 下减少 18.57% 的信道使用，并优于对比的 JSCC 方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SemQAM，将矢量量化与 QAM 调制相结合，实现联合语义信道编码与调制，并支持多 SNR 和 CBR 的统一模型。
analysis.method: 使用矢量量化表示潜在特征，将 VQ 索引映射到 QAM 符号，并通过接收码字的条件期望来降低自回归编码中的误差传播。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 SemQAM，一种联合语义信道编码与调制的生成式图像传输方案，利用矢量量化和 QAM 符号映射来提升传输效率。

papers.abstract: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.

analysis.key_results: 模型参数0.2483M，计算量0.0949 GMACs，在域内和外部数据集上保持有竞争力的分割精度；与8位乘法的Gemmini systolic-array加速器相比，计算阵列面积减少88.46%（45nm工艺）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TernScope方法，结合模型-硬件协同设计，将紧凑分割网络与三值量化感知训练结合，实现低参数、低计算量的高能效分割，并在硬件层面显著减少计算阵列面积。
analysis.method: 采用分割通道大核块以保留空间上下文，分支融合去除冗余推理路径，并应用三值渐进量化感知训练（TPQ），使所有25个卷积使用三值权重和8位激活。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TernScope通过模型-硬件协同设计与三值量化感知训练实现了高能效的内窥镜分割。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于医学图像分割的模型量化与硬件协同设计，未涉及视觉语言动作模型或世界模型，但所提低比特量化与硬件加速方法对机器人视觉模型的高效推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME上，SERA自演化选择后总体成功率达51.38%，未自演化为44.38%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SERA（Self-Evolving Robotic Agent），将高层VLM组织为机器人智能体，通过可编辑框架维护任务上下文并利用执行经验改进规划，实现自演化。
analysis.method: 固定VLA执行器提供低层控制，可编辑框架利用观测和执行反馈维护并更新任务上下文，通过环境rollout提议和评估框架修订，选定配置后进行测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SERA系统，通过可编辑的框架将高层VLM规划器与固定VLA执行器结合，以自演化方式维持任务上下文并提升历史依赖操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接扩展VLA模型在长程历史依赖操作任务中的能力，核心为VLA执行器与高层VLM规划器的结合，属于VLA应用与机器人操作策略学习范畴，对本站VLA主题具有直接研究价值。

papers.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

analysis.key_results: 在4B到35B参数的混合模型上，PACE（混合4/8比特头）在内存约八比特DAMP的2/3下达到相当性能；纯四比特头PACE在相同内存下优于Q-Mamba；周期性轮询保持解码加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入PACE，一种后训练四比特状态量化器，通过周期性轮询、通道对齐量化和混合精度头减少循环状态量化误差。
analysis.method: PACE采用周期性轮询（每几个token量化一次）、通道对齐量化（共享量化尺度）、混合精度头（部分头保持八比特）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种后训练四比特状态量化器PACE，通过周期性轮询、通道对齐量化和混合精度头来降低线性注意力语言模型循环状态的内存占用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于线性注意力语言模型的循环状态量化，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但该量化技术可潜在地应用于机器人世界模型或VLA中基于线性注意力的高效推理。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

analysis.key_results: RCSD在多个基准上平均接受长度比HASS提升35%，端到端推理速度比HASS快1.35倍，且不损失生成质量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了RCSD（Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding）训练框架，将草稿模型优化与系统级目标（最大化接受长度）对齐，利用推测推理中自然产生的接受/拒绝序列构建偏好对，并引入掩码损失避免惩罚目标对齐的token。
analysis.method: 强化学习与持续学习相结合；利用推测推理过程中的接受和拒绝序列作为隐式偏好对；使用掩码损失防止惩罚与目标模型对齐的token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RCSD训练框架，通过强化与持续学习优化推测解码中的草稿模型，以最大化接受长度并加速推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型推测解码的效率优化，未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）、WAM（世界-动作模型）或机器人任务。然而，其训练框架和系统级优化思想可潜在迁移到机器人策略模型或多模态VLA中的自回归解码加速。

papers.abstract: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

analysis.key_results: 在游戏和机器人操作中达到0.898和0.942的代理归因准确率，因果生成器在512×448分辨率下达到17.70 FPS。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LiveAct及异构动作接口HAI，通过代理感知空间调制和模式引导动作适配解决多智能体独立控制和异构控制问题，并迁移到块状因果生成器实现实时流式生成。
analysis.method: Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation（语言驱动空间门控和代理特定注意力）与Schema-Guided Action Adaptation（语言描述控制变量并调制语义令牌），结合教师强制和rollout感知分布匹配迁移到因果生成器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出LiveAct与异构动作接口HAI，用于多智能体视频世界建模，支持独立控制和异构控制，并实现实时因果生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向世界模型（WAM），并在多机器人操作场景中验证，涉及视觉未来预测和机器人命令，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B的2位和3位量化上，OnQ取得九项基准平均最优，长程推理提升最大；2位时在所有基准和模型规模上均优于基线，Qwen3-8B平均分比最强基线高10.26分，且生成响应更短、截断和重复错误更少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OnQ低比特恢复流水线，结合on-policy蒸馏和候选级动态KL散度，解决量化模型在长程推理任务上的性能下降和终止问题。
analysis.method: OnQ使用块级校准初始化，量化学生模型自生成响应，教师模型对学生自身前缀进行监督；动态KL根据教师-学生概率比调整前向与反向KL权重，以校正欠预测和过预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OnQ，一种结合on-policy蒸馏和候选级动态KL散度的量化感知训练流程，以恢复低比特LLM的长序列推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于低比特LLM的量化感知训练，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人相关方法，但所提出的模型量化与高效推理技术可潜在地用于减少机器人策略或世界模型的计算开销。

papers.abstract: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.

analysis.key_results: 移动机器人导航仿真显示在杂乱环境中的鲁棒性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出结合流匹配路径规划与模型预测控制的框架，实现数据驱动路径生成与实时约束感知执行。
analysis.method: 流匹配模型捕获多模态路径分布，预测控制器在线调整运动以满足状态和输入约束并避障，采用事件触发重规划方案。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种将流匹配路径规划与模型预测路径跟随控制相结合的框架，以实现约束感知和避障的机器人导航。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to remember task-relevant information beyond its short observation window. Existing memory-augmented policies typically retrieve relevant information from history and reason over it at execution time, placing a heavy reasoning burden on the high-level model. To address this challenge, we propose PAL (\textbf{P}lan first, \textbf{A}ct \textbf{L}ater), a hierarchical memory framework for vision-language robot manipulation. It maintains a short-term visual buffer, a semantic-event memory, and an executable \texttt{subtask\_list}. A high-level vision-language model (VLM) converts streaming visual observations into the \texttt{subtask\_list}. At execution time, the VLM selects the currently relevant subtask from the \texttt{subtask\_list} and passes it to a low-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy. To teach the model what to write to memory and when to update it, we introduce a two-stage data generation procedure that first expands sparse update supervision and then uses self-labeling with task-grounded verification to generate training data that better match the state distribution encountered during execution. We evaluate our approach on memory-dependent benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. On RoboMME, PAL achieves a \textbf{56.05\%} success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline, FrameSamp-Modul, at 44.51\%. In real-world experiments across four manipulation tasks, \pal{} reaches \textbf{60.83\%} overall success, surpassing MemER (45.00\%) and FrameSamp-Modul (28.33\%). These results show that proactively writing future-relevant subtasks into hierarchical memory improves long-horizon visual reasoning and robot control. Code and videos can be found on our website: https://qinghangliu.github.io/pal-webpage/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME基准上，PAL取得56.05%成功率，超过最强基线FrameSamp-Modul（44.51%）；在四个真实世界操作任务中，PAL总成功率达60.83%，超过MemER（45.00%）和FrameSamp-Modul（28.33%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PAL（Plan first, Act Later），一个面向视觉语言机器人操作的层次记忆框架，通过高层VLM将流式视觉观察转化为可执行子任务列表，并在执行时由低层VLA策略选择相关子任务执行，从而减轻高层模型的推理负担。
analysis.method: 维护短期视觉缓冲、语义事件记忆和可执行子任务列表；高层VLM将视觉观察转化为子任务列表，执行时选择相关子任务传递给低层VLA策略；采用两阶段数据生成过程，先扩展稀疏更新监督，再利用自标注和任务基验证生成与执行状态分布更匹配的训练数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PAL，一个层次记忆框架，通过高层VLM将视觉观察转化为子任务列表，并由低层VLA策略执行，以减轻高层模型的推理负担。

papers.abstract: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. Beyond predictive accuracy, our evaluation framework characterizes the geometry and invariances of learned EEG representations across measurable spatial, temporal, and spectral signal properties.

analysis.key_results: 在睡眠分期、注意力评估和认知负荷估计等任务上匹配或超越现有最优模型，同时参数减少高达 97%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个轻量级脑电图基础模型 BrainCodes，通过量化神经 tokenizer 和自监督学习，在多个神经监测任务上达到最优或相当性能，同时参数减少高达 97%。

papers.abstract: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a small labeled set. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B at 3 and 4 bits, composed models reach lower mean held-out perplexity than every single-family model in all six settings, and the fidelity mode lowers perplexity and KL further. In a matched scaffold, final-output scoring gives lower held-out KL than representation-similarity scoring in all 12 paired runs. With labels from training or development splits of the evaluated task families, the target-adapted mode raises 3-bit pooled accuracy on the two Llama models by 4.3 and 4.5 points over the best single-family model. At 3 bits, unquantized embedding and output layers make up 43-46% of the packed artifact. All evaluations use general-domain benchmarks on a ground GPU; space-domain tasks and flight hardware are left to future work.

analysis.key_results: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B上3/4比特量化，组合模型困惑度均低于单一家族模型；目标适配模式在3比特下将两个Llama模型的准确率提高4.3和4.5个百分点；3比特量化时未量化的嵌入和输出层占打包模型的43-46%。

papers.abstract: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

analysis.key_results: 模型能识别大类活动，但难以识别咳嗽、打喷嚏、哈欠等细粒度动作；时间线重建不准确；会幻觉出涉及物体的动作；简单的热输入预处理和额外推理仅带来有限且依赖模型的改进；拒绝回答行为在不同模型间差异很大。
analysis.main_contribution: 填补了视觉语言模型在热成像人类活动理解中失效模式研究的空白，通过在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上的诊断任务，揭示了模型在细粒度动作识别、时间线重建和幻觉等方面的不足。
analysis.method: 在两个人中心热成像数据集上评估七个本地可部署的视觉语言模型，诊断任务包括细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建和不确定时拒绝回答，并以RGB记录作为对照，分析帧采样、热输入预处理和推理策略的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 评估了七个本地可部署的视觉语言模型在热成像人机交互场景下理解人类活动的失效模式。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

analysis.key_results: Think-Capture-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 上达到 54.4%（比主干高 21.5 分），在 MMSI-Bench 位置子集上 39.1%（+7.9），在 ViewSpatial 上 42.8%（+5.2），且在坐标和掩码扰动下保持鲁棒；完整堆栈适配单张 24GB GPU，并作为 Agibot G1 上的异步高层推理器。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.

analysis.main_contribution: 刻画了目标概率重用能保证精确重用所需的条件，并提出两种基于目标分布的树选择规则，其在多种目标模型上相比草稿排序提高了预期接受率和解码速度。
analysis.method: 理论分析精确重用条件，并实验对比基于目标分布的重排序和首token采样再分配树的方法。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) navigation models translate visual observations and instructions into actions. Navigation success assesses whether an agent reaches the goal. However, reaching the goal successfully does not establish whether the model genuinely follows the instructions or relies on visual cues or navigation history. We introduce NavBind to diagnose instruction-action binding: whether changing the instruction influences the probabilistic distribution of the actions, with the navigation context fixed. We construct 3,252 route-fork contexts by recombining route-aligned instruction segments from R2R-CE and RxR-CE. Each context pairs full instructions that share the description of the route already traveled but specify different branches. Both are evaluated under the same agent state and navigation history. We compare generated local action sequences, the likelihoods of fixed reference action sequences under both instructions, and changes in visual attention and attribution. Across the evaluated models, higher reported navigation success does not imply that the model more faithfully follows the instructions.

analysis.key_results: 在评估的模型中，较高的导航成功率并不意味着更忠实地遵循指令；摘要未提供具体数值。

analysis.method: 构建3,252个路径分叉上下文，将R2R-CE和RxR-CE中的指令片段重组，使完整指令前半部分相同、后半部分指定不同分支，并在相同智能体状态和历史下比较动作序列、参考动作似然、视觉注意力和归因的变化。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) are shown to substantially diverge under generalization performance based on their generative backbones. We investigate this gap through the representational geometry that WAMs inherit from their backbones and how policy training reorganizes it. Our central hypothesis is that a useful representational prior would structure geometry that separates nuisance information from the in-distribution manifold in advance of training as a policy. We quantify this with nuisance orthogonality; orthogonality of the feature under visual variation outside the empirical in-distribution manifold. Across various image and video backbones, we show that a higher orthogonality from the representational prior is associated with stronger robustness to visual variations after WAM training, enabling policy generalization measurable prospectively for world models. In addition, analyzing the resulting robust WAMs reveals nuisance suppression; relative suppression of feature displacement caused by such variations and robust action generation of the policy. Together, these findings provide a geometric perspective on how the representational prior of the world model shapes the generalization performance of WAMs.

analysis.key_results: 更高的扰动正交性与更强的视觉变化鲁棒性相关，并实现了策略泛化的前瞻性预测；鲁棒世界动作模型表现出扰动抑制和策略动作生成的鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop (HIL) post-training improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through expert corrections, but costly human supervision and repeated real-robot evaluation limit algorithm exploration and development. We introduce SimPT (Simulation-based Post-Training), a simulation framework that automates intervention-based VLA post-training by integrating policy rollouts, corrective data collection, policy training, and standalone evaluation. To automatically determine intervention timing and recovery strategies, we develop an Agent-Compiled Progress Graph that tracks task progress using privileged simulator state and retains stable snapshots during policy execution. After a rollout fails, a CuRobo-based expert attempts recovery from these snapshots, starting at more advanced task stages and falling back to earlier ones as needed to generate corrective trajectories. We implement and compare four post-training methods, RECAP, HG-DAgger, DPO+SFT, and FlowPRO, across seven RoboTwin manipulation tasks. Relative to a fixed-interval snapshot baseline, the Progress Graph reduces recovery attempts by 75.0% and increases recovery success from 93.4% to 98.9%. Using SimPT, we develop RECAP-CF-LPF, a refinement of RECAP that combines cross-fitting and low-pass filtering of value predictions. This refinement increases the overall success rate from 76.50% to 79.36% in held-out simulation trials. In real-robot HIL post-training, it increases the success rate from 72% to 96% across 25 scenarios of an Ethernet cable-insertion task. These results demonstrate the utility of SimPT for exploring and developing VLA post-training algorithms.

analysis.key_results: 进展图使恢复尝试减少75.0%，恢复成功率从93.4%提升至98.9%；开发RECAP-CF-LPF，在仿真中总成功率从76.50%提升至79.36%，真实机器人HIL后训练中成功率从72%提升至96%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SimPT，一个自动化干预式VLA后训练的仿真框架，并开发Agent-Compiled Progress Graph来自动确定干预时机和恢复策略。
analysis.method: 集成策略rollout、纠错数据采集、策略训练和评估；使用基于CuRobo的专家从进展图快照进行恢复；比较RECAP、HG-DAgger、DPO+SFT、FlowPRO四种后训练方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SimPT仿真框架，通过自动化干预、纠错数据采集、策略训练与独立评估，实现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的仿真后训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA策略的后训练，通过仿真自动化干预与数据采集，对VLA训练中的高效探索具有重要意义。

papers.abstract: Frontier black-box Large Language Model (LLM) agents are proficient at long-horizon reasoning and precise action generation. However, when it comes to a specific agentic task, they have no internalized knowledge of how that particular environment unfolds. A world model offers a natural remedy, providing the agent with environment specific knowledge by foreseeing how the environment will respond to the action it is about to take. Prior world models for LLM agents mainly predict next observations at each step, which is costly and often uninformative because individual observations provide limited task-relevant guidance and not every step requires call for foresight. This raises a key question: what a world model should predict and when should it be invoked for agentic tasks? Our pilot study suggests that world model guidance is most useful when it anticipates pitfalls within a bounded multi-step future. Motivated by this, we introduce Pitfall Anticipation World Model (PAWM), which selectively intervenes when a potential pitfall arises and predicts the impending failure to steer the agent away from it. PAWM is trained in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic data labeled with agent pitfalls, followed by GRPO co-training with a black-box LLM to further optimize it in the target environment. PAWM improves Claude Sonnet 4.5 performance by 24.3% on ScienceWorld and 7.7% on WebArena-Lite, outperforming a range of baselines. These results demonstrate that PAWM provides an effective form of world model guidance for black-box LLM agents.

analysis.key_results: PAWM在ScienceWorld上使Claude Sonnet 4.5性能提升24.3%，在WebArena-Lite上提升7.7%，优于多种基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PAWM，一种选择性地在潜在陷阱出现时进行干预并预测即将发生的失败的世界模型，用于引导黑盒LLM智能体。
analysis.method: 两阶段训练：在标注智能体陷阱的合成数据上进行监督微调，随后与黑盒LLM进行GRPO协同训练以在目标环境中进一步优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出陷阱预期世界模型（PAWM），有选择地在可能出错时预测即将发生的失败，以引导黑盒LLM智能体远离陷阱。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于黑盒LLM智能体的世界模型引导，不涉及机器人VLA或机器人世界模型，与本站主题无直接关系，但其世界模型思想——有选择地预测未来陷阱而非每一步观测——对机器人的高效世界建模可能具有方法论借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.

analysis.key_results: 合成任务中OOD RMSE从1.769降至0.697；CausalWorld中已知PD模型将分布外质量下的中位R2从0.609提升至0.727（p=0.002），学习扭矩模型与最强RWM配置竞争。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出在机器人世界模型中显式将物理参数（如连杆质量）注入惯性项和动力学偏置项，并利用已知控制器或学习扭矩网络提升分布外预测性能。
analysis.method: 合成基准中的因果依赖掩码干预实验，以及CausalWorld中手指局部世界模型的仿射参数化和显式物理系数建模。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究世界模型在物理条件偏移下的泛化，通过因果建模与显式物理参数编码提升机器人在分布外质量下的预测精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究机器人世界模型在物理参数偏移下的鲁棒性与泛化，属于VLA/WAM核心主题。其显式物理参数建模方法对现实世界机器人世界模型的部署具有直接方法论价值，虽然未涉及VLA策略学习，但为WAM的可靠预测提供了关键改进。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. Most of it remains at matched supervised length and at each objective's best measured training length. A second vision corpus shows the shrinkage, as does a text-only replication, for distillation also with an autoregressive drafter. Objective gains should therefore be measured against a target-regenerated baseline and across training lengths. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration.

analysis.key_results: 在外部响应上蒸馏和门控蒸馏带来显著增益，但贪心重生成后蒸馏增益变小，门控增益几乎消失；该现象在数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度、初始化、学习率、监督长度和训练长度等条件下普遍存在。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现草稿训练目标相对交叉熵在外部响应上的增益，在目标模型贪心重生成后大部分消失，并建议在目标重生成基线和不同训练长度下评估目标增益。
analysis.method: 以视觉-语言模型为目标模型、块草稿模型为草稿器，在四种语料版本上训练三种目标：语料标记交叉熵、目标模型的词元级蒸馏、以及仅针对可保留位置的蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究投机解码中草稿训练目标在目标模型重生成草稿后所获增益的衰减情况。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文为投机解码的独立研究，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人模型。然而，其关于训练目标增益评估的结论对使用投机解码加速视觉-语言或具身模型具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from $N^2$ to $Nk$ per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for $k\le8$, on Pythia-70M.

analysis.key_results: 在DeiT-Tiny、MambaIRv2-Light和Pythia-70M上，编译后的模型与全键参考模型匹配，标准训练后量化适用；精确尾质量估计优于尾丢弃，在DeiT-Tiny和k≤8的Pythia-70M上仅需一半键数即可达到更好效果。
analysis.main_contribution: 展示每个包含注意力、LayerNorm和GELU MLP的Transformer块可以精确编译为通用深度神经网络，同时证明对于top-k注意力，精确或条件均值尾质量能够给出无偏且最小均方误差的注意力分布估计。
analysis.method: 将Transformer块编译为使用固定仿射映射、路由、平方、sigmoid、逆平方根及GELU或其sigmoid近似的基础操作组合；利用多智能体注意力聚类，通过质心先选择键来降低计算量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文证明Transformer块可以精确编译为仅使用固定仿射映射、路由、平方、sigmoid和逆平方根等基础操作的通用深度神经网络，并展示标准训练后量化依然适用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于Transformer模型的编译和量化效率，未直接涉及VLA或世界模型，但其提出的通用编译方法和训练后量化适配性可能对机器人策略或世界模型中Transformer模块的高效部署具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.

analysis.key_results: 在 PDDL 任务中，验证器引导的后训练将 4B-14B 紧凑规划器的成功率提升至 70.5-76.0%；在 Jetson Orin 上 INT4 部署的平均功耗为 17.85-26.41 W。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出神经符号压缩与微调框架 SLoSa，训练小型、低功耗且安全的基础模型用于机器人任务规划。
analysis.method: 首先使用经典规划器、教师 LLM 和形式验证器构建安全感知数据集，然后进行监督微调和基于验证奖励机的强化学习微调以强制安全对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SLoSa 通过神经符号压缩与安全对齐微调，训练出适用于资源受限机器人平台的小型、低功耗、安全的任务规划模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注机器人任务规划中大型语言模型的高效部署（低功耗、小模型），通过 INT4 量化压缩模型并验证其在边缘平台和物理机器人上的可行性。虽不直接涉及 VLA 或世界模型，但其量化与安全对齐方法对资源受限的机器人学习系统具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: NVIDIA tensor cores have supported 2:4 semi-structured sparsity since Ampere, and the pattern composes with quantization. When the two are combined, the practical question is which step to take next: from a given precision, add 2:4 sparsity or drop to the next lower precision? We compare the two at equal bits, with sparsity metadata counted, and at equal nominal tensor-core tiers, over all six GEMM operands of a transformer layer, with kernels measured on three GPU generations and online pruning and quantization included. Our results show that as long as a lower precision is available, adding 2:4 is the worse step, both less accurate and slower, because the energy that 2:4 discards from each group of four along the hardware-forced axis does not shrink with bits, while quantization error does. Once quantization reaches the lowest precision the hardware supports, 2:4 still speeds up linear layers by 1.3--1.7\x{}, and on an H100 a retrained 2:4 model served in FP8 by vLLM reaches 27\% higher prefill throughput than the dense FP8 model, with GSM8K accuracy on par. Its quality has to be won back by retraining, however, which restores perplexity long before reasoning; on Blackwell, whose sparse FP4 uses a pairwise 4:8 pattern, the loss is larger and our retraining budget did not recover it.

analysis.key_results: 量化误差随比特减小而减小，而2:4丢弃的能量不随比特缩减，因此只要存在更低精度，添加2:4在精度和速度上均更差；量化至硬件支持的最低精度后，2:4仍可加速线性层1.3-1.7倍；在H100上经重训练的2:4 FP8模型相比密集FP8模型预填充吞吐提升27%，GSM8K准确率相当；2:4质量需重训练恢复，困惑度恢复早于推理能力；在Blackwell的稀疏FP4上损失更大且重训练未能恢复。
analysis.limitations: Blackwell上的2:4稀疏（4:8配对模式）损失较大，重训练预算未能恢复质量。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统比较2:4半结构化稀疏与量化对于Transformer层各GEMM算子的准确率-速度权衡，在同等比特数、考虑稀疏元数据及同等张量核层级的条件下。
analysis.method: 比较等比特下的2:4稀疏与低精度量化，并在三个GPU代际上实际测量所有六个GEMM操作，且包括在线剪枝与量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 对比半结构化2:4稀疏与量化在LLM推理中的效率与精度权衡，发现量化优先更优，稀疏仅在最低精度后作为加速手段有效。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM中的量化与稀疏性，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其推理效率优化方法可潜在应用于机器人策略模型部署。

papers.title: Is 2:4 Sparsity Still Worth It? Semi-Structured Sparsity versus Quantization in LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: 2:4 稀疏性还值得吗？LLM 推理中半结构化稀疏与量化的对比

papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，该方法在三种骨干模型上均取得了强劲的整体性能，并验证了经验引导的预测控制的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种受MPPI启发的测试时框架，结合多分支预测分析和基于经验的适应机制，并引入双分支经验记忆实现自我改进。
analysis.method: 在每个步骤中，智能体提出多个候选动作，利用世界模型预测其结果，通过评估任务进展和风险得到代价，再用MPPI风格的权重指导最终决策；双分支经验记忆分别用于改进候选生成/动作选择和下一观察预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种测试时框架，结合多分支预测分析与经验自适应，使LLM智能体在文本环境中实现自改进决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文的核心是世界模型在决策中的应用，尽管实验在文本环境（ALFWorld和ScienceWorld）中，其世界模型与预测控制框架对机器人世界模型（WAM）和策略学习具有方法论启示，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人操作。

papers.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class experimental axis in CP evaluations for language-model systems.

papers.abstract: Human video scales easily and does not need robot hardware, but existing methods require depth sensing, overlay the robot onto 2D video, or generate data only for the demonstrated objects. We present Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R), a real-to-semantic-to-real pipeline that turns one monocular RGB video of a human demonstration into thousands of robot demonstrations across the semantic object instances of a category. R2Sem2R tracks the SE(3) pose of each object with DINOv3-distilled Gaussian splats, outperforming existing methods and FoundationPose with estimated metric depth. R2Sem2R then aligns digital cousins, each generated from one or a few photographs, to the demonstrated objects with a semantic alignment. This alignment matches whole objects and the functional regions of target objects, such as a coffee machine's tray. R2Sem2R maps the human hand to a feasible robot grasp that extends to the cousins. Robot demonstrations are generated either in IsaacSim, for photorealistic rendering, or MuJoCo, for contact physics, and R2Sem2R can generate over 2,000 episodes in about two hours. On two real robots and four tasks, we train a vision-language-action policy on data from one human video per task, and policies trained on our data match or exceed policies trained on teleoperation across diverse object instances. The project page is available at https://real2sem2real.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在四个任务和两个真实机器人上，基于单个视频生成的数据训练VLA策略，性能匹配或超过基于遥操作训练的策略；演示生成速度快，约两小时可生成超过2000个episode。

papers.abstract: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient {\lambda} setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the reshaped weights do less damage, a plain gradient-norm penalty does not reproduce the effect, and a preliminary extension to three small language models shows the same tail shaping. With a BCH code over 1% of the weights the model then survives 300 progressive bit-search flips in every training seed and 500 in two of three, where three of four published defenses with the same code fail by 300 and WCAT falls to 75% at 500. The reshaped distribution also cuts the parity for a fixed guarantee 3.7 times and makes a sensitivity-ordered 8/6/4/3-bit format affordable, which stores ImageNet ResNet-50 at a 3.29-bit weight payload, 2.4 times smaller than INT8, above the accuracy of LSQ at 3 bits.

analysis.key_results: 在九个视觉模型上将敏感尾部缩小 5 至 13 倍，准确率损失在 0.5 点以内；使用 BCH 码覆盖 1% 权重后，模型可承受 300 次渐进位搜索翻转；与 LSQ 相比，ImageNet ResNet-50 在 3.29 位权重负载下达到更高准确率。

analysis.method: 在训练的最后几个 epoch 或微调阶段添加复合正则项，包括限制翻转步长的范围项和降低最敏感权重梯度的尾部项，通过系数 λ 控制分布移动程度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过损失工程调制权重敏感性分布，提升模型对位翻转的容错性并实现更紧凑的非均匀量化。

papers.abstract: Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). A three-source decomposition localises the amplification to the learned policy (zero ODE-solver contribution, bounded anchor mismatch); the coverage plateau is an unconditional benefit of mode-separating priors that no amount of RL capacity recovers. The remedy is conditional: a non-Gaussian prior is necessary precisely when the latent geometry would fall into overlap and the task is coverage-sensitive. A machine-checked theory skeleton supports the KL pricing structure - a divergent compactness tax under a Gaussian prior versus a finite assignment fee under a mixture - and the position-versus-plateau distinction delimits what is finite-resource from what requires changing the prior.

analysis.key_results: 在真实丙氨酸二肽玻尔兹曼分布上，高斯先验VAE在β_c=0.224崩溃，而模式跟踪的混合高斯先验在0.00316崩溃，相差71倍；几何中介变量为d_min/(2σ_0)；通过受控干预验证因果链。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究RL微调下VAE高斯先验的失效条件，发现多模态数据会导致模式重叠和崩溃，并提出混合高斯先验作为条件性补救。

papers.abstract: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.

analysis.key_results: PTQ使NRMSE增加6.25和7.04个百分点，QAT-FT恢复约90.2%和94.5%的损失；累积更新阈值减少约99.7%的更新和77-80%的状态转换，NRMSE仅增加0.042和0.197个百分点。

papers.abstract: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

analysis.key_results: 在Meta-World、Adroit和DM-Control上，SDI在每个套件的平均任务得分均高于所有对比基线，并在18个任务中有15个达到或超过最强基线；消融实验和鲁棒性分析验证了探索、规划暴露和行动接受的作用，成对评估显示门控比无门控规划更好地恢复演员失败并保留成功行为，同时显著减少回报退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination），通过共享演员参考连接探索与规划决策，无需额外分歧集成即可同时提供探索信号和行动接受准则。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SDI方法，利用世界模型中的同一演员参考比较想象动作序列，统一指导探索与规划，提升智能体在连续控制任务中的性能。

papers.abstract: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.

analysis.key_results: 在文本驱动多样骨骼动画方面比视频优先流程更忠实，运动响应周围场景；支持视频到骨骼运动、骨骼运动到视频转换以及基于关键帧的3D运动控制。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个模型，直接为任意提供的骨骼绑定协同生成视频和3D运动，并包含一个将运动注册到场景的相机。
analysis.method: 将3D运动保存在独立模型中，通过少量交叉注意力层与预训练视频模型连接；使用生成式视频编辑器将动画3D资产放置在场景中策展训练数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种协同生成视频与3D运动模型，适用于任意骨骼绑定，并能从视频中恢复相机与3D运动。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于视频生成与世界建模领域，可用于机器人数据生成和运动控制，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型，对本站主题有间接参考价值。

One model covers joint generation (top two rows) and either conditional direction (bottom two rows). Mesh animation: a rigged monkey clears a scene’s high-jump bar, adapting its motion to the surroundings. figures.caption: Architecture overview. Given a text prompt, a rig, and an optional reference image, the model jointly denoises video latents Z v Z_{v} and motion tokens Z m Z_{m} . A graph network encodes the rig into per-joint descriptors D D , using the joints’ 2D locations in the reference image, and these condition the motion branch; a graph-attention layer inside each Motion DiT block propagates features along the rig edges. Zero-initialized cross-attention bridges exchange features in both directions at paired blocks, each branch querying the other’s intermediate features, so joint training begins from the two pretrained branches acting as they did in isolation. An auxiliary joint-localization head (right) attends from joint features to video patches and returns each joint’s image position as a weighted combination of patch coordinates, giving 2D–3D correspondences used to fit a camera.

papers.abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

analysis.key_results: 在组合拾取放置（MolmoSpaces）和RMBench记忆依赖子集上优于同骨干基线（如FastWAM）；在RMBench上达到34.5%，超过使用关键帧的Mem-0（28.5%），且仅使用单锚帧；真实世界Find-the-Item任务中，文本记忆使成功率从11.1%提升到61.1%，而最先进VLA仅≤33.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniWALM，一个统一的WAM模型，将视频、动作和语言三种模态整合到单一共享表示中，并以同步扩散方式生成，实现语言作为记忆的闭环，无需外部规划器或记忆库；同时引入Flow Matching with Correction (FMC)训练目标。
analysis.method: 采用混合Transformer骨干网络的单一模型，各模态扩散头同步去噪；生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，形成语言记忆循环；FMC通过扰动动作轨迹训练来提高动作流的鲁棒性，且无推理时开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一世界-动作-语言模型UniWALM，在单一扩散Transformer骨干中同步生成视频、动作和文本，并通过语言记忆循环提升操作与记忆依赖任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于WAM领域，将世界模型、动作预测和语言记忆统一到单一模型，对VLA和WAM的发展具有核心意义。

papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.

analysis.key_results: 该设计消除了写入时的字幕生成，并在全部450次测试解码中，缓存令牌解码复现了未拆分模型的输出。
analysis.main_contribution: 一个共享时空记忆系统，通过将视觉编码与语言解码分离、按需生成描述、视觉令牌缓存及PII抽象，扩展了NVIDIA ReMEmbR至机器人车队，提升了隐私保护与计算效率。
analysis.method: 在机器人上使用Jetson进行视频编码（Cosmos-Embed1嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge视觉令牌、Wan2.2 VAE潜变量），将Cosmos3-Edge在视觉-语言边界拆分，视觉编码器留在机器人端，语言解码器置于本地服务器，由Nemotron代理按内容、位置和时间检索记忆并利用缓存的视觉令牌生成描述。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出IndustrialRemembr系统，通过按需生成场景描述、在机器人端编码视觉信息并缓存视觉令牌的服务器端解码，降低车队规模机器人共享时空记忆的算力与通信成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文通过模型拆分与缓存机制提升机器人车队中时空记忆系统的推理效率，间接涉及视觉-语言模型的高效推理，但未直接聚焦VLA或世界模型。其按需解码与令牌缓存策略对机器人高效率推断有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（Medusa头）、Meta MTP模型和Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP上，于AIME 2025和GSM8K评测，AMTP最高比标准解码快4.1倍，在10个设置中有8个匹配或优于固定窗口，吞吐量增益最高达10%。
analysis.main_contribution: 将MTP的horizon选择形式化为在线控制问题，提出AMTP轻量级控制器，利用验证反馈学习不同上下文中可信的草稿长度，无需重训练且不改动验证器。
analysis.method: 采用接受生存概率刻画每个horizon的期望接受令牌数，每轮解码前由AMTP预测草稿可能存活的距离，选择期望每秒令牌数最高的horizon；使用在线梯度下降实现次线性遗憾。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AMTP控制器，在线学习多令牌预测（MTP）的最佳推测horizon，无需重训练且保持验证器不变，能提升解码吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的推测解码效率优化，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、世界模型（WAM）或机器人策略；但其在线自适应推测horizon的方法可能对机器人VLA的高效推理有潜在迁移价值，摘要未明确讨论。

papers.abstract: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $\pi_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

analysis.key_results: 在四个真实世界操作任务中，世界模型策略评估与真实成功率的任务级 Pearson 相关算术平均值从 0.602 提升至 0.885；策略后训练使 π0.5 的平均真实成功率从 59.1% 的 SFT 基线提升至 70.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PhysCanvas，一个状态一致的视觉触觉世界模型，统一多视图 RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态和动作，并通过一致性感知后训练提升策略评估与学习的可靠性。
analysis.method: 使用统一的视频 VAE 和预训练生成骨干网络，结合正向运动学和相机投影生成的运动图像进行空间对齐的动作条件化，并利用初始 RGB 锚点和更新参考观测引导序列生成；采用冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型和状态奖励模型进行一致性感知后训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PhysCanvas 提出一个统一多模态视觉触觉世界模型，通过一致性感知后训练来支持接触丰富机器人操作任务的策略评估与强化学习。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于机器人的世界模型（WAM），即接触丰富操作场景下的交互式仿真器，用于策略评估和 GRPO 策略更新，通过多模态一致性和状态对齐提升对真实结果的预测能力，与 VLA/WAM 主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.

analysis.key_results: 在VP-WorldBench和现有4D生成基准上，点监督提升了视频保真度和3D运动精度；在仿真与真实机器人实验中，动作模型的操作成功率有所提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出视频-点模型（VPM），一个以多视角视频和语言指令为条件、同时预测未来任意视角视频及持久3D点轨迹的世界模型，并扩展到机器人控制。
analysis.method: 扩展预训练世界模型，加入相机条件多视角处理与轨迹头；轨迹与视频联合监督；控制扩展将机器人动作作为token，与未来视频联合去噪。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出视频-点模型，通过联合预测多视角未来视频和持久3D点轨迹，并在同一3D感知表示下扩展到机器人控制，以提升动态场景理解与操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于世界模型（WAM）范畴，通过3D点轨迹监督增强动态场景建模，并扩展到机器人控制，与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）及机器人世界模型的核心主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

analysis.key_results: 在指令跟随、推理和编码任务上，流模型达到或超过自回归模型质量；自推测解码吞吐量是自回归模型的2.54倍，优于多token预测和离散扩散方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出大型流式语言模型Lafa，可扩展到80亿参数，支持前缀缓存和块并行解码，并通过自推测解码实现2.54倍吞吐量提升。
analysis.method: 块状流模型（因果前缀注意力+双向异步流），从预训练自回归模型改编，采用自推测解码（流草稿自回归验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种可扩展的连续流语言模型Lafa，通过块状流建模与自推测解码实现高效并行生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的高效推理，不涉及VLA或世界模型，但其推测解码技术可潜在应用于机器人策略模型的加速推理。

papers.abstract: Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在32个独立采样的计算图目标上，LeWi是未给定目标图时样本效率最高的方法，平均学习曲线面积比密集网络低27%；在17个世界模型预测任务上，LeWi在16个任务上优于密集基线，并在119个基线比较中赢得99个。
analysis.limitations: 密集网络在单一高元数函数目标上表现更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Learned Wiring（LeWi）方法，让每个神经元具有可学习的低维嵌入，仅邻近神经元连接，嵌入和权重联合训练，从而利用隐藏的组合结构提高样本效率。
analysis.method: Learned Wiring（LeWi）：神经元学习低维嵌入，依据嵌入空间中的邻近性确定连接，嵌入和权重联合训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了学习连接（LeWi）方法，通过神经元的低维嵌入和邻近连接来学习计算结构，以提高在组合稀疏目标上的样本效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文提出一种学习计算结构的方法，并在世界模型预测任务（包括控制、导航、操作）上验证了其提高样本效率的有效性，与WAM主题存在方法学关联，但未涉及VLA。

papers.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
papers.title_zh: 学习计算结构以实现样本高效预测

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. Furthermore, at a short recovery budget, calibration and recovery data are coupled. The best recovery data depends on the calibration data, so the two must be chosen jointly. The resulting recipe involves a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and an inexpensive codebook-only recovery stage. Including codebooks, it uses about $2.3$ effective bits per weight and retains $89$ to $97\%$ of full-precision question-answering (QA) accuracy where scalar PTQ is at chance, and, including recovery, uses $1.4$ to $30\times$ less compute than the strongest quantization-aware-training (QAT) baseline.

analysis.key_results: 2比特下，标量PTQ降至随机水平；向量码本恢复可提升准确率；QA任务保留89-97%全精度准确率，计算量比最强QAT基线少1.4-30倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种面向2比特训练后量化的数据中心配方，包括向量码本表示、任务对齐的小型校准混合和仅码本恢复阶段，在QA任务上保留89-97%全精度准确率，计算量比最强QAT基线少1.4-30倍。
analysis.method: 使用向量码本作为量化表示，结合任务对齐的校准数据混合和码本恢复微调；校准与恢复数据联合选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究2比特训练后量化中表示、校准数据与恢复微调数据的选择，提出向量码本和联合校准/恢复数据配方，在低计算预算下恢复模型精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文研究独立于机器人领域的模型量化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略/世界模型。但其高效推理技术（2比特量化与恢复）可潜在应用于机器人模型的部署压缩，具有方法学参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
papers.title_zh: 超越4比特：以数据为中心的训练后量化与恢复

papers.abstract: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上，对五种接触丰富交互进行评估；语义接触建模显著提高了演示交互的保持度，生成式伙伴状态建模在五种交互中的四种上改善了接触召回率；真实硬件上机器人仅使用机载传感执行了所有交互。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出REACT框架，利用语义接触结构作为关键监督信号，连接演示处理、交互学习和机载控制，并通过VLM引导接触建模和生成式伙伴状态建模实现从人-人演示到人形机器人的策略迁移。
analysis.method: VLM引导的接触建模与重定向流水线，接触感知奖励的特权交互策略学习，光真实感人体深度渲染的蒸馏，以及生成式伙伴状态建模目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: REACT框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的接触建模和生成式伙伴状态建模，从人-人演示中学习可部署的人形机器人交互策略，以应对严重部分可观测性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究属于机器人操作与视觉语言模型（VLM）交叉领域，利用VLM进行接触语义理解，并通过生成式建模处理部分可观测性，对VLA在接触丰富交互中的实际部署具有直接参考价值；但未明确涉及世界模型（WAM）的概念。

A privileged teacher then learns the interaction with contact rewards and is finally distilled into an egocentric depth student that predicts the partner’s motion and runs on the real robot.
