papers.abstract: Video models provide rich priors for generalizable robotic manipulation, but plausible visual futures are not always executable. We introduce DreamCan, a hierarchical policy that grounds video models through sparse visual planning: a high-level planner adapted from a pre-trained video model and a low-level visuomotor policy. Rather than predicting dense trajectories, the high-level planner generates sparse visual subgoals that balance reachability and task utility. From offline, action-free robot videos, we estimate these quantities and use dynamic programming to select subgoal sequences without manual annotations. The resulting subgoals are more reliably attained than uniformly spaced alternatives, and the full system outperforms language, dense-video, and uniform-subgoal planners, reaching high planning success rates on Language-Table tasks and 91.2% success on LIBERO-Long with a 0.1B-parameter low-level policy. Additional suboptimal videos and test-time compute further improve success. The system also performs challenging real-world bimanual tasks, including box folding and packing with unseen object combinations. More results are available at https://dreamcan.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在Language-Table任务上达到高规划成功率，在LIBERO-Long上以0.1B参数的低层策略实现91.2%成功率；增加次优视频和测试时计算可进一步提升成功率；在真实世界双手操作任务（如叠箱子和打包未见物体组合）中也能有效执行。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入了一种新的分层策略，通过稀疏视觉规划将视频模型的能力接地到可执行的机器人操作中，无需手动标注即可从离线无动作视频数据中自动选择子目标序列。
analysis.method: 使用从预训练视频模型适配的高层规划器生成稀疏视觉子目标，并通过动态规划基于可达性和任务效用选择子目标序列；低层采用视觉运动策略执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DreamCan，一种利用预训练视频模型生成稀疏视觉子目标并进行分层规划的机器人操作策略，以提升任务可执行性和泛化性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作通过结合预训练视频模型与视觉运动策略进行分层规划，与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）密切相关，展示了如何利用视频世界知识提升机器人操作策略的泛化性和长程任务性能。

papers.abstract: We study quantization for inner-product estimation when storage and reading have separate budgets. In the static bit-probe model [Yao, 1981], an encoder stores $w$ bits about $x$ before seeing a query $y$, and a reader probes at most $r<w$ bits to estimate $x^\top y$. Both vectors lie in the $d$-dimensional Euclidean unit ball. Protocols may be randomized, and computation is unrestricted. Performance is measured by $d$ times the worst-case mean-squared error over $x,y$, averaged over protocol randomness. First, we show that query-independent reading cannot benefit from extra storage. Any such reader is equivalent to fully reading an $r$-bit message, even when later reads depend on previously returned bits. At fixed positive rates $W=w/d$ and $R=r/d$, the normalized minimax error converges to $1/(4^R-1)$, independent of $W$. The upper bound was already known [Ordentlich and Polyanskiy, 2025]. We prove the matching lower bound for arbitrary scalar decoders, extending the result for unbiased compressors [Safaryan et al., 2020]. Then, we show that query-dependent reading makes extra storage useful. We construct a two-batch protocol using Gaussian projections and random thresholds, with asymptotic normalized error at most $(\pi+o(1))/[4R\log(W/R)]$ as $W/R\to\infty$. At fixed $R$, this error vanishes as storage grows, giving an unbounded advantage over query-independent reading. We also prove a finite-dimensional lower bound for arbitrary encoders, decoders, and fully branching readers. In the doubly sparse regime $W/R\to\infty$ and $R\log(W/R)\to0$, it gives normalized error at least $(1-o(1))/[2R\log(W/R)]$. Thus, our protocol is optimal within a factor of $\pi/2$ in the leading constant.

analysis.key_results: 在查询独立读取下，归一化极小极大误差收敛于1/(4^R-1)，与存储量W无关；在查询依赖读取下，构造的两批协议渐近归一化误差至多为(π+o(1))/[4R log(W/R)]，且当W/R→∞时误差趋于0，优于查询独立读取；此外，给出了有限维下界(1-o(1))/[2R log(W/R)]，表明该协议在领先常数上至多相差π/2。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了查询依赖读取可以利用额外存储显著降低量化内积估计的误差，并构造了一个两批协议，其误差随存储增长而消失，而查询独立读取则无法从额外存储中获益。
analysis.method: 采用静态位探针模型，构造了基于高斯投影和随机阈值的两批协议，并利用了极小极大分析和信息论工具。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了在存储和读取预算分离的条件下，量化内积估计中查询依赖读取相对于查询独立读取的优势，并给出了相应的极小极大误差界。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是纯理论量化压缩研究，不涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人策略。其关于利用查询依赖读取来利用额外存储的结论可能为模型量化中基于输入的动态解码提供间接理论启发，但与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Lifelong robot learning requires acquiring new tasks sequentially without forgetting earlier ones. With large pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) backbones, adapter-based methods effectively mitigate this challenge. However, their task-specific adapters and selection modules accumulate with the task stream, creating a scalability challenge in on-disk storage and deployment cost under fixed onboard resource budgets. We propose SARAM, a lifelong learning framework that limits storage growth while keeping GPU memory and per-step inference cost independent of the task stream length. For each new task, SARAM reuses frozen adapters from previous tasks and introduces new adapters only at sparsely selected layers, with a duplication penalty encouraging them to capture information not already represented by the adapter library. At deployment, a compact signature derived from backbone activation statistics identifies the task once per episode, and the corresponding task update is merged into the backbone, leaving only the backbone in the control loop. Across four LIBERO suites, SARAM matches or exceeds adapter-based baselines while adding up to 4.5x less on-disk state per task. GPU memory usage and control frequency remain comparable to those of the backbone as the task stream grows. Experiments on a real UR5 arm with a different backbone further demonstrate retention throughout a sequential task stream.

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO套件上，SARAM与基于适配器的基线相比性能相当或更优，每个任务的磁盘状态增加最多减少4.5倍；GPU内存使用和控制频率随任务流增长保持与骨干网络相当。在真实UR5机械臂上验证了不同骨干下的保留能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SARAM框架，在终身机器人学习中限制存储增长，同时保持GPU内存和每步推理成本与任务流长度无关。
analysis.method: 对每个新任务，复用之前任务的冻结适配器，仅在稀疏选择的层引入新适配器，并施加复制惩罚以促进捕获适配器库中未表示的信息；部署时基于骨干激活统计的紧凑签名每个回合识别任务，并将相应任务更新合并回骨干网络。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SARAM通过稀疏分配新适配器、复用旧适配器并在部署时合并任务更新，实现终身机器人学习中的存储增长控制和推理成本恒定。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）骨干进行终身机器人学习，在保持策略性能的同时实现高效推理和存储，属于VLA高效部署和策略学习的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Can a better robot policy become harder to monitor? We study a fixed vision-language model (VLM) that judges success while a policy improves. In a controlled 20-seed tray-placement experiment, training selects only simulator-verified successes. Success rises from 66.8% to 97.0%, and accepted hover failures fall from 5.0% to 0.9% of executions. Yet the judge accepts 50.0% of remaining hovers, versus 31.1% under untrained sampling. These residual failures more often lie below the tray rim, which can conceal the gap beneath a grasped cube. A separate boundary probe accepts 148/160 below-rim hovers and 0/160 above-rim hovers. We call this change in conditional monitoring sensitivity coverage shift: learning changes which failures reach a fixed judge. A broader diagnosis covers nine judges and 1,392 stimuli. Judge-filtered experiments across eight settings further show heterogeneous effects of state-dependent acceptance. The results distinguish task improvement from failure detectability and motivate reporting absolute misses, conditional misses, and audit coverage together.

analysis.key_results: 策略成功率从66.8%提升到97.0%，接受的悬停失败比例从5.0%降至0.9%，但VLM对剩余悬停失败的接受率从31.1%升至50.0%；边界探针接受148/160个边缘下方悬停和0/160个边缘上方悬停。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实证分析了“覆盖偏移”（coverage shift）现象：当机器人策略在学习过程中提升时，剩余失败样本的条件分布发生变化，导致固定VLM判断器的监测敏感性改变。
analysis.method: 在受控托盘放置实验中，使用固定VLM作为成功判断器，比较训练前后策略的失败样本被VLM接受的比例，并通过边界探针实验区分不同失败模式（如托盘边缘下方悬停）的检测差异。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究固定视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人策略提升时对成功与失败的判断能力变化，发现策略改进后剩余失败更难被VLM正确识别，表现为覆盖偏移现象。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究VLM作为机器人成功监测器的可靠性，涉及机器人操作策略与视觉语言模型的交互，对VLA系统的安全评估与部署具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Existing Multi-token prediction (MTP) methods are auxiliary by design: the multi-horizon loss mostly trains modules attached to the backbone, and each added horizon costs another module and another pass. We propose Efficient Causal Self-Recursion (ECHO), which removes both costs. The backbone's own final layer predicts every horizon, so the supervision lands on the parameters that generate the next token, and Dynamic Depth Sampling (DDS) keeps deeper horizons affordable by drawing the training depth with probabilities that decay along depth. Future prediction thus becomes part of the autoregressive objective rather than a task attached to it, and the gains follow on both sides of it. In pretraining, added depth converts into downstream accuracy where auxiliary modules saturate, concentrating on reasoning and code at half the MTP training overhead of training every depth. At inference, the pretrained model is its own drafter: it drafts beyond the depth it was trained for, and keeps its draft-target alignment on the open-ended, high-entropy generation where post-hoc drafters lose theirs. The advantage survives a doubled token budget, a repeated pretraining run, and supervised finetuning.

analysis.key_results: 在预训练中，增加深度转化为下游精度提升，相比训练所有深度仅需一半的训练开销；在推理中，预训练模型可自起草超出训练深度的令牌，并在开放式高熵生成中保持草稿与目标对齐。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出高效因果自递归（ECHO）方法，通过骨干网络自身最终层预测所有前瞻步长，避免额外模块和多次前向传递，将未来预测纳入自回归目标而非附加任务。
analysis.method: 骨干网络最终层自递归预测多步；动态深度采样（DDS）以随深度衰减的概率采样训练深度，保持深层预测可负担。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出高效因果自递归方法，使骨干网络自递归预测多步令牌，减少多令牌预测的训练与推理开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的高效多令牌预测与推测解码，未涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM），但其自递归草稿方法若应用于机器人策略模型，可能提升推理效率，属于具有潜在迁移价值的独立效率技术。

papers.abstract: The scan-then-revisit workflow of upper gastrointestinal endoscopy requires bringing a previously observed suspicious region back into view for closer inspection. Acquiring such targets requires translating anatomical and appearance descriptions into camera motions from partial observations of a confined, deformable environment. We present EndoVLA-OOV, a language-conditioned vision-language-action policy for out-of-view target acquisition in robotic endoscopy. The policy adapts a pretrained backbone to continuous two-degree-of-freedom distal bending commands and combines initial, intermediate, and current images to guide search. To support policy learning, we provide an open-source VLA dataset containing 1,050 episodes across six tasks and approximately 262k observation-action pairs. Physical evaluation spans wet-lens and low-light conditions, two unseen stomach phantoms, and cross-embodiment transfer to an unseen ex-vivo environment. In the cross-embodiment evaluation, the full-data policy achieves 93.3% target acquisition success (28/30). In a controlled training-data comparison, expanding the corpus from 312 to 1,050 episodes increases acquisition success from 40.0% to 90.0% under the same model, training, and test configuration. Instruction and observation interventions further support the use of language and temporal context in the evaluated acquisition tasks. These results support language-guided endoscopic revisitation across the evaluated environments and robot embodiments and demonstrate the benefit of expanded task-specific demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在跨实施例评估中，全数据策略达到93.3%的目标获取成功率（28/30）；将语料从312扩展到1,050回合后，相同配置下成功率从40.0%提升至90.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EndoVLA-OOV策略，并发布一个包含1,050个回合、约262k观察-动作对的开源VLA数据集，用于内窥镜视野外目标获取。
analysis.method: 将预训练骨干适配到连续二自由度远端弯曲命令，并结合初始、中间和当前图像来引导搜索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出EndoVLA-OOV，一个语言条件的视觉-语言-动作策略，用于机器人内窥镜中视野外目标的再获取。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是面向机器人内窥镜应用的VLA策略，直接属于VLA在具体机器人操作任务中的研究，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

papers.abstract: Spatial understanding is essential for robots to perceive their surrounding environments and execute actions. Existing approaches typically encode 3D awareness into vision-language-action (VLA) models by directly aligning their representations with pre-trained 3D foundation models. However, we observe that such direct geometric feature alignment essentially exploits 3D foundation priors as a form of low-rank regularization in the feature space, resulting in severe rank collapse of the pre-trained VLA representations. In contrast, we shift the focus from enforcing point-wise equality to aligning pair-wise relationships. We propose a representation-alignment method that enables the injection of 3D spatial awareness without compromising the model's original expressivity. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks, our new spatial reasoning benchmark, and real-world manipulation scenarios demonstrate that our approach effectively incorporates 3D spatial representations into VLA reasoning, achieving robust performance and enhanced spatial awareness across diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.method: 将3D空间先验通过成对关系对齐注入VLA表征，而非逐点几何特征对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出用成对关系对齐替代逐点对齐，将3D空间意识注入VLA模型，避免预训练表征的秩坍缩。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

analysis.key_results: 在空间心理建模基准上，V2W在无训练设置下大幅提升VLM基线，学习探索策略后达到最优性能。

analysis.method: 根据多视图图像重建显式3D世界（含几何、相机位姿和语义），通过视觉和语言接口让VLM多轮交互获取空间证据，并可用强化学习优化探索策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出V2W框架，使视觉语言模型通过主动探索显式3D世界来提升空间推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于以显式3D世界为对象的世界模型研究，虽未直接面向机器人控制，但主动空间推理与世界建模对VLA/WAM的3D环境理解、探索与空间证据获取具有方法论借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Digital medicine now captures data that traces individual health trajectories and reveals population health dynamics through electronic health records, claims, remote monitoring, wearable devices, mobile devices, social sensing data, medical images, etc. But much of its modeling still centers on task-specific, outcome-specific, and prediction-specific estimation. The next frontier is not simply better prediction, but action in an evolving health world shaped by multiple decision-makers, heterogeneous populations, resource constraints, and feedback in care delivery. This is why digital medicine now needs world models: not only to estimate what will happen, but to represent how actions change what can happen next -- whom to prioritize, how to allocate scarce resources, how to adapt care across subgroups, and how interventions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics. We call such a model population health world model (PHWM): a more foundational representation of an evolving health world in which health states, individual trajectories, population health dynamics, interventions, constraints, and feedback are intrinsically coupled. Building a PHWM endows three unmet structural gaps in current digital medicine: dynamic health-state modeling, population-level intervention intelligence, and validation, equity, and governance for action-oriented use. We argue that addressing these gaps requires three minimal capabilities: representation learning under action-dependent observation, multi-scale intervention intelligence, and validation with explicit decision boundaries, while highlighting the importance of social, contextual, and public-health sensing data for action-oriented digital medicine.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明

analysis.method: 该框架需要三个最小能力：动作依赖观测下的表示学习、多尺度干预智能，以及带有明确决策边界的验证；同时强调社交、情境和公共卫生感知数据的重要性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出人群健康世界模型（PHWM），将健康状态、个体轨迹、人群动态、干预、约束和反馈耦合在一起，以推动数字医学从预测走向行动。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于数字医学领域的人群健康世界模型，而非机器人或具身智能中的VLA/WAM。但其世界模型思想—尤其是动作如何改变未来状态、干预如何重塑动态轨迹—与机器人世界模型方法论有相通之处，可作为跨领域参考。

figures.caption: Overview of Population Health World Model: Observed health signals—including electronic health records, claims, wearable and remote-monitoring data, patient-reported outcomes, and social or contextual signals—feed into a population health world model that distinguishes latent health state from recorded observations. The model represents intervention space, transition dynamics, uncertainty, and hierarchy across levels and time scales, linking patient-level health trajectories to subgroup patterns and population health dynamics. Interventions and real-world constraints jointly shape intervention-conditioned dynamics, which in turn support action-oriented outputs such as prioritization, scenario analysis, coverage planning, and resource allocation. Validation and governance form an integrated layer spanning the framework, emphasizing predictive validity, intervention sensitivity, counterfactual plausibility, robustness under shift, usefulness, and equity.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Structural Gaps and Minimal Required Capabilities in Population Health World Model. Current digital medicine models rely on assumptions that observed features approximate health state, that decisions can be modeled at the patient level, and that evaluation under observed processes is sufficient. These assumptions lead to three structural gaps: (1) representational challenges arising from latent state being confounded with intervention-dependent observations, (2) multi-scale coupling challenges due to interactions across individuals, subgroups, and populations under shared constraints, and (3) validation challenges under intervention, feedback, and distribution shift. Addressing these gaps requires minimal capabilities rather than optional directions: representation learning under action-dependent observation, multi-scale intervention intelligence, and validation frameworks with explicit decision boundaries. These priorities correspond to core problem classes in artificial intelligence, including partially observable modeling, multi-agent and hierarchical systems, and off-policy and uncertainty-aware evaluation.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

analysis.method: 训练一个带感知编码器的30B因果语言模型，接受文本和图像输入，集成多步推理、可靠工具使用和失败恢复，并量化为约4-bit精度以支持本地部署。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs strains onboard computational resources during real-time inference. This directly increases energy consumption and limits vehicle battery range, making it critical to minimize computational overhead without compromising driving capability and explainability. Current research on efficient VLA-based driving focuses on sequential adaptation (\textit{e.g.}, Chain-of-Thought and token adjustment), leaving structural adaptation underexplored despite parameter redundancy across dynamic driving scenes. To address this gap, we propose Scene-Adaptive VLA, an efficient framework leveraging dynamic layer routing to adjust active parameters based on real-time scenes. Inspired by the temporal continuity of scenes and model predictive uncertainty, our approach characterizes model-perceived scene complexity via frame-level temporal scene variations and decision deviations. To uncover latent scene-to-parameter correspondences, we encode this characterization into scene-aware tokens, alongside two specialized queries. A budget-conditioned layer routing mechanism evaluates these refined queries to allocate a budget that determines the active parameter ratio and subsequently selects appropriate layer combinations. The entire framework is optimized end-to-end. Extensive evaluations on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that when adapted to a state-of-the-art VLA model, our approach significantly reduces inference-time computational overhead by 53.5\% with negligible degradation in driving and language capabilities. Code is available at https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA.

analysis.key_results: 在Bench2Drive基准上，将所提方法应用于最先进的VLA模型，推理计算开销降低53.5%，驾驶和语言能力几乎无退化。

papers.abstract: LIBERO has emerged as a widely adopted benchmark for evaluating robotic manipulation policies. However, strong performance on LIBERO does not necessarily indicate robust embodied capabilities, as models may exploit benchmark-specific regularities rather than generalize to diverse operating conditions. In this work, we introduce LIBERO-Pro2.0, a comprehensive benchmark for systematically evaluating the robustness of embodied foundation models under distribution shifts. LIBERO-Pro2.0 encompasses 22 static perturbations and 20 runtime interventions across six dimensions: Condition, Environment, Observation, Execution, Robot State Configuration, and Language, yielding 1,648 validated shifted task instances. To support robustness-oriented learning, we further collect 39,390 training trajectories through model-generated and human demonstrations. All shifted task instances undergo six rounds of iterative human review and correction to ensure physical plausibility and task validity. We evaluate 17 representative robot policies spanning vision-language-action models, world-action models, and robustness-oriented policies. Our results reveal substantial robustness gaps across all evaluated paradigms: under runtime distribution shifts, the evaluated models exhibit an average performance drop of 26.5 percentage points, with individual drops reaching 32.5 points. These findings highlight the gap between nominal benchmark performance and robustness under distribution shifts, underscoring the need for systematic robustness evaluation of embodied foundation models.

papers.abstract: Frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies cannot incorporate previously encountered failures without updating the underlying model. We present retrieval-triggered projection correction (RTPC), an auditable external-memory wrapper for frozen OpenVLA policies that retrieves stress-collected local-depth records and applies translation-only projection correction while keeping rotation and gripper commands unchanged. RTPC is evaluated on CALVIN single-task manipulation using primary and independent replication cohorts. In the primary evaluation, RTPC reduced a depth-based near-collision or stall proxy event rate without changing task-success count. However, this reduction was not reproduced in the independent replication, and retrieved correction directions were not distinguishable from random same-family directions. Analysis identifies endpoint coupling, batch sensitivity, and the lack of a trigger-matched memory-free baseline as limitations for attributing effects to retrieval-based correction. These findings do not establish physical safety improvement or memory-specific benefits, but provide an empirical evaluation and failure analysis of retrieval-conditioned intervention for frozen VLA policies.

analysis.key_results: 在 CALVIN 单任务操作上，RTPC 在主要评估中降低了基于深度的近碰撞或停滞代理事件率，但未改变任务成功次数；该降低在独立复现中未被重复，且检索到的校正方向与随机同族方向不可区分。
analysis.limitations: 端点耦合、批次敏感性以及缺乏触发匹配的无记忆基线，限制了对检索式校正效应的归因；研究未能确立物理安全改进或记忆特异性益处。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出检索触发投影校正（RTPC），一种可审计的外部记忆包装器，通过检索压力采集的局部深度记录并对冻结 OpenVLA 策略进行仅平移的投影校正，并以严格的双队列复现实验对其进行评估和失败分析。
analysis.method: 检索触发投影校正（RTPC），为冻结 OpenVLA 策略添加可审计外部记忆，检索压力采集的局部深度记录并施加仅平移投影校正，保持旋转和夹爪指令不变。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出并对冻结 VLA 策略的检索触发投影校正外部记忆包装器进行了实证评估，发现其未能可靠复现效果且归因困难。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对冻结 VLA 策略的干预与实证评估，属于 VLA 的核心研究范畴；其关注点是基于检索的记忆增强和失效分析，相对于 WAM 主题，重点是策略行为校正与可归因性。

papers.abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to participate effectively in social interactions is important for their integration into human-centered environments. Existing methods, however, typically map pre-generated speech directly to continuous motion trajectories but have limited awareness of complex social environments and lack explicit high-level semantic action planning. We introduce SocialCoAct, a unified agent-centered framework for VLM-based egocentric social co-action. We formulate egocentric social co-action as an end-to-end agent task and develop SocialCoAct-Agent, which transforms egocentric observations and dialogue history into verbal responses and atomic action sequences, aligns each action with its corresponding utterance span, and executes the resulting behaviors in MuJoCo and on a physical humanoid robot. To evaluate the VLM capabilities required by this task, we construct SocialCoAct-Bench from continuous egocentric recordings of natural multi-party interactions. The benchmark comprises 423 human-verified multiple-choice questions across three subtasks: Long Episode Understanding (LEU), Speaker Intention Understanding (SIU), and Coordinated Action Planning (CAP). Across a diverse set of closed-source and open-weight VLMs, including general and egocentric models, the highest overall accuracy is 77.54%, while accuracy on the hard subset reaches only 46.51%. Extended reasoning improves Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B by 19.62 and 17.02 percentage points, respectively, but reduces inference throughput by 53.6$\times$ and 20.2$\times$. Visual-input ablations further show that the benefits of visual context vary across models. SocialCoAct provides a foundation for developing and evaluating VLM-based humanoid agents that coordinate context-aware speech and action in complex social interactions. The codebase and benchmark will be made publicly available upon publication.

analysis.key_results: 在多个闭源和开源VLM上，最高总体准确率为77.54%，困难子集准确率仅为46.51%；扩展推理使Qwen3-VL-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B分别提升19.62和17.02个百分点，但推理吞吐量分别下降53.6倍和20.2倍；视觉输入消融显示视觉上下文在不同模型上的益处存在差异。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了SocialCoAct框架和SocialCoAct-Agent，以及SocialCoAct-Bench基准，用于评估VLM在自我中心社会协同行动中的能力。
analysis.method: 将自我中心社会协同行动建模为端到端智能体任务，利用VLM将自我中心观察和对话历史转换为言语响应和原子动作序列，并将每个动作对齐到相应的语句片段，在MuJoCo和实体人形机器人上执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一个以VLM为核心的自我中心社会协同行动框架与基准，使人形机器人能够根据观察和对话生成言语响应及原子动作序列，并在仿真和实体机器人上执行。

papers.abstract: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

analysis.key_results: 控制仿真显示HWM在速度、加速度和加加速度估计上更准确，并显著降低长视距能量漂移；在RoboCasa上Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B任务成功率相对提升2.7%；在AgiBot World真实轨迹上Ctrl-World的nDTW提升9.7%，EVAC的Logic提升8.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HWM框架，在学习的相空间中使用广义坐标和动量表示主干潜变量，通过耗散哈密顿动力学传播未来状态，并可集成到现有世界模型架构中。
analysis.method: 将主干潜变量映射到由广义坐标和动量构成的学习相空间，通过耗散哈密顿动力学传播未来状态，并利用可学习的逆接口映射回原潜变量空间；结合多步转移监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出结构化潜变量动力学框架HWM，通过在相空间中利用耗散哈密顿动力学传播潜变量，以提升长视距具身世界模型预测的稳定性和实用性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对具身世界模型（embodied world models），属于WAM核心主题，通过结构化状态演化提升长视距预测的物理一致性和稳定性，对机器人动作条件世界建模具有重要意义。

papers.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a post-hoc calibration method that returns prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees, and the size of the output set is often interpreted as a notion of uncertainty. We show that the difference in set size between full and split CP is directly connected to Bayesian posterior variance, which is the epistemic uncertainty of the model. Essentially, this difference in set size is an aggregation of two opposite effects: (1) better model accuracy and therefore smaller set size achieved by training over extra calibration points, and (2) the "formability" of the model at test point towards every possible label. The latter effect vanishes with stronger models or more calibration data (as epistemic uncertainty is known for that behavior). It turns out that the model's formability itself (without the quantization effect of prediction sets, and through estimating the posterior variance) is a useful tool to quantify the epistemic uncertainty. In our empirical evaluation it performs on par with the state of the art in many setups.

analysis.key_results: 模型的可塑性作为认知不确定性的量化工具，在多数实验设置中与最先进方法表现相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示一致性与分割一致性预测的集合大小差异直接关联贝叶斯后验方差（认知不确定性），并证明模型的可塑性本身可用于量化认知不确定性。
analysis.method: 通过分析完整与分割一致性预测的集合大小差异，将其分解为模型精度提高和模型可塑性两个相反效应，并利用贝叶斯后验方差估计来量化可塑性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文将完整一致性与分割一致性预测的集合大小差异与贝叶斯后验方差（即认知不确定性）联系起来，并提出模型可塑性本身可作为量化认知不确定性的有效工具。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies must ground language instructions in the right objects, contact points, and target locations for reliable manipulation. Human gaze provides a natural signal for this grounding, but existing robot datasets rarely pair real human gaze with the multi-camera observations used by modern policies. We introduce GazeAct, a gaze-equipped real-robot manipulation dataset and training framework for multi-view VLA policies. Using screen-based teleoperation, we record gaze directly on the robot camera feed viewed by the operator, yielding 12000 demonstrations across 40 tasks and five domains with 300 Hz gaze synchronized with images, proprioception, and actions. We transfer gaze from the operator-selected view to the remaining synchronized cameras, producing spatially consistent targets across the policy's visual inputs. We then use these gaze-derived targets to regularize language-conditioned visual attention during training while keeping inference gaze-free. Across 18 real-world tasks, our method improves average success from 48.1% to 58.6%, with gains up to 25 percentage points. Ablations show that gaze works best as soft supervision and that real human gaze provides stronger attention targets than generic attention-shaping priors. The gains transfer to LIBERO-Spatial (57.9% to 69.6%) and different VLA backbones.These results show that gaze collected in the robot observation space can provide effective training-time targets for improving visual grounding in VLA manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在18个真实世界任务中，平均成功率从48.1%提升至58.6%，最高提升达25个百分点；在LIBERO-Spatial上从57.9%提升至69.6%；消融实验表明注视作为软监督效果最佳，真实人类注视比通用注意力塑造先验提供更强的注意力目标。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了GazeAct：一个包含12000条演示、40个任务、5个域、300Hz注视同步的机器人操作数据集，以及一种利用人类注视对VLA策略进行注意力正则化的训练框架，且推理时无需注视输入。
analysis.method: 通过基于屏幕的遥操作在操作员观看的机器人相机视角上直接记录注视，将注视从操作员选择的视角转移到其余同步相机以生成空间一致的目标，然后在训练过程中使用这些目标对语言条件视觉注意力进行正则化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GazeAct构建了一个带有同步人类注视数据的多视角真实机器人操作数据集，并利用注视作为软监督来正则化VLA策略的语言条件视觉注意力，从而提升操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，通过人类注视数据改善VLA在机器人操作中的视觉基础能力，属于VLA核心研究，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. Covering 20,431 UniProt-reviewed human proteins, it integrates curated bioactivity evidence and distinguishes experimental inactivity from unmeasured associations. On 198 held-out molecules, GenFish achieves higher mean performance across all three full-catalogue retrieval metrics than four discriminative neural baselines and three non-neural baselines, including ligand-based methods. A controlled positive-hiding experiment shows that targeted removal of false-negative competition improves contrastive retrieval beyond matched random masking; GenFish remains stronger under the same incomplete supervision. Pfam alignment indicates that the semantic identifiers capture biologically meaningful relationships among proteins. These results establish generative retrieval as a principled paradigm for reverse target fishing under incomplete bioactivity records.

analysis.key_results: 在198个保留分子上，GenFish在全部三个全目录检索指标上平均性能优于四个判别式神经基线和三个非神经基线；阳性隐藏实验表明其方法在相同不完全监督下更强；Pfam比对显示语义标识符捕获了生物学上有意义的蛋白质关系。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GenFish生成式检索方法，并构建首个蛋白质组尺度的逆向靶点发现基准ProTargetBench。
analysis.method: 利用残差向量量化将蛋白质语言模型特征转换为共享语义标识符，以分子指纹为条件自回归建模标识码，基于似然排序蛋白质。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种基于残差向量量化的生成式检索方法GenFish，用于在蛋白质组尺度进行逆向靶点发现，并构建了首个相关基准ProTargetBench。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是向量量化在蛋白质检索任务中的应用，与机器人视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型无直接关系。

papers.abstract: GUI world models are increasingly used to improve action selection by predicting the consequences of candidate actions, but it is unclear how much of the resulting gain comes from prediction itself rather than from the evaluator that interprets those predictions. We study this attribution problem through controlled interventions on GUI action selection. With candidates and predictions held fixed, lookahead gains can change with how the prediction is presented to the evaluator, so end-to-end gains cannot be attributed to prediction alone. We then introduce Direct Action Ranking (DAR), which learns from reference actions to score candidates without generating future screens, and compare it with a prediction-augmented variant under matched supervision. Predicted successors add no detectable ranking signal once evaluation is learned directly. Without retraining, DAR improves AndroidWorld task success by 5.8--16.4 points across three proposers, outperforms world-model lookahead, and transfers zero-shot to unseen apps, where every prediction-conditioned configuration falls below proposer confidence. These results suggest that GUI world models should be evaluated by their decision value, the incremental action-selection value of their predictions beyond a strong direct evaluator, rather than by prediction fidelity or end-to-end lookahead gain alone.

analysis.key_results: DAR改善AndroidWorld任务成功率5.8-16.4个百分点；预测后继无额外排序信号；零样本转移中性能优于世界模型前瞻。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Direct Action Ranking (DAR)，无需生成未来屏幕即可对候选动作打分，并验证其优于世界模型前瞻，证明GUI世界模型应以决策价值而非预测保真度评估。
analysis.method: 通过受控干预归因预测与评估器的贡献；DAR从参考动作学习评分；对比预测增强变体；在AndroidTask和零样本APP上评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究GUI世界模型中预测本身与评估器对动作选择增益的归因，并提出直接动作排序方法以评估世界模型的决策价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，FlashMap 在每个基准测试中都比匹配的 DFlash 基线更快，平均加速比提高 7%，最高实现 6.1 倍无损加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 FlashMap，一种连续流草稿模型，将流图语言模型以目标模型隐藏状态为条件，在单次前向传播中生成整个块同时捕获 token 间依赖。
analysis.method: 使用以目标模型隐藏状态为条件的连续流草稿模型，在单次前向传播中生成整个 token 块并捕获 token 间依赖。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 FlashMap，一种基于流图的连续流草稿模型，在单次前向传播中生成整个 token 块并捕获 token 间依赖，从而加速大语言模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的推测解码，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人技术。但所提出的高效推理方法可能为在机器人策略或世界模型中部署大模型提供借鉴。

papers.abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 方法在多个下游任务上一致提升现有位置编码器性能，且RevGeoRQ进一步超越当代位置编码器。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并设计了RevGeoRQ架构，同时使用残差量化语义ID提供可解释的地理表示。
analysis.method: 使用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号，应用于现有位置编码器架构；提出RevGeoRQ自定义架构，采用残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并引入RevGeoRQ架构及残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究地理位置编码器，采用残差量化技术，与本站VLA/WAM主题无直接关系；但残差量化语义ID表示对量化方法在空间表示学习中的应用具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly. Explicit grounding substantially improves success and reaches state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks across three scene collections. We also correct annotation defects in these benchmarks, so that future methods are evaluated more faithfully. Our analysis on the clean benchmarks shows that, with ground-truth grounding, our policy nearly matches the expert that generated its demonstrations, leaving the headroom in perception rather than policy learning. Our work points to goal grounding as a missing piece of object-goal navigation and offers a simple and effective solution to the task.

analysis.key_results: 在六个基准、三个场景集合上达到最先进成功率；使用真实接地时策略接近生成演示的专家水平。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别目标接地为对象目标导航的主要失败模式，并提出显式目标接地方法，在多个基准上取得最先进结果；同时修正基准中的标注缺陷，提供更忠实的评估。
analysis.method: 显式目标接地：使策略能够注意到目标已在视野内并估计其距离，而非仅依赖隐式视觉语言模型策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作诊断并解决对象目标导航中策略的目标接地失败问题，通过显式目标接地显著提升成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于视觉语言机器人导航策略学习（VLA），通过诊断目标接地失败并显式建模目标位置，改进了基于VLM的导航策略，与本站关注的VLA策略学习和机器人操作/导航直接相关。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\times$ longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 最宽松设置下，有损验证平均每轮接受token数是无损的1.34倍，但生成长度是无损的1.54倍；仅在被有损验证接受的token往往目标模型概率较低；减少验证轮数的规则通常伴随准确率大幅下降；部分失败源于持续推理耗尽预算而未能给出最终答案。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别并揭示了有损推测解码中的生成长度膨胀现象，指出仅用每轮接受token数衡量速度的不可靠性。
analysis.method: 对12个target-drafter对应用现有的无训练有损验证规则，在相同提示下与无损验证对比，测量生成长度、验证轮数、实际耗时和任务准确率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究发现有损推测解码虽然增加了每轮接受的token数，但会导致生成长度膨胀，从而抵消效率提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对通用推测解码的效率评估，与机器人VLA/WAM无直接关系，但其中的长度膨胀问题可能对机器人策略生成等有损解码场景具有警示意义。

papers.abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.

analysis.key_results: 在H100上预填充最高比编译的PyTorch FP8快1.48倍，达到1.29 PFLOP/s；8B和70B形状下INT4解码比PyTorch BF16和INT4块快1.3-2.4倍；完整Llama-3.1-8B解码每步2.8毫秒，而编译的transformers实现为8.1毫秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FUTRANSFORMER，一个结合FP8预填充与INT4解码的Hopper GPU CUDA实现，显著提高了Transformer推理速度。
analysis.method: 采用CODA的GEMM+epilogue方法，融合RMSNorm增益、直接写入FP8输出、无填充预填充，解码使用INT4投影权重与INT4 KV缓存，并利用块对角Hadamard变换降低缓存量化误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种针对NVIDIA Hopper GPU的Llama风格Transformer块CUDA实现，通过FP8预填充与INT4解码加速推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于独立的大语言模型量化加速推理，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型，因此与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

analysis.key_results: 在通用、长上下文和代理工作负载上达到 2-6 的接受长度，比最先进方法 DSpark 提升最高 70%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DLite，一种面向代理 AI 的无历史投机解码框架，通过复用目标模型上下文隐藏状态和轻量顺序头，将复杂的上下文建模问题转化为局部简单预测问题。
analysis.method: DLite 直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态进行局部投机预测，无需显式维护历史上下文；使用轻量顺序头恢复块内因果依赖；并采用两阶段训练策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DLite 针对代理 AI 中长且持续演化的上下文，提出无历史投机解码框架，通过复用目标模型隐藏状态进行局部预测，避免显式维护历史 KV 缓存。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。本文专注于 LLM 推理加速的投机解码技术，不涉及视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型或机器人领域。

papers.abstract: Typed decision models often return more than a selected category. They also expose probabilities for each candidate and, sometimes, a separate confidence score. These fields support downstream decisions but may reveal information beyond a recipient's authorization. We introduce TUPLE-Bench (Typed decision models' Utility and Privacy Leakage Evaluation Benchmark), a benchmark of paired synthetic cases in which recipients may learn a coarse operational category but not its fine-grained cause. Across nine models, instructions to withhold the cause fail to protect it: 91.88%-99.93% of responses reveal the cause through direct selection or residual scores. Even when causes are excluded from the candidate set, full outputs enable 62.85%-75.35% recovery on held-out cases, compared with 51.04%-57.64% using only the selected category (50% chance). Full outputs also reduce mean downstream cost in all 27 model-task comparisons. However, confidence fields increase leakage without consistently reducing cost. We further introduce workflow-constrained privacy quantization (WCPQ), which reduces secret recovery while preserving the behavior and cost of specified downstream workflows. Our findings highlight the need to audit decision interfaces field by field and workflow by workflow.

analysis.key_results: 91.88%-99.93%的响应通过直接选择或残差分数泄露原因；仅用选定类别时恢复率为51.04%-57.64%，完整输出为62.85%-75.35%；置信度字段增加泄露但未一致降低效用。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入TUPLE-Bench基准和WCPQ方法，评估并减少Typed Decision Models的隐私泄露，同时保持下游工作流的行为和成本。
analysis.method: TUPLE-Bench基准和workflow-constrained privacy quantization (WCPQ)方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TUPLE-Bench基准和WCPQ量化方法，评估并缓解类型化决策模型输出字段导致的隐私泄露问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于类型化决策模型的隐私-效用权衡及量化方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但提出的量化方法可能对高效推理和模型优化有一般性参考价值。

papers.abstract: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.

analysis.key_results: 在五个GSM8K草稿-目标模型对上，学习到的稀疏协作解码比最佳开环调度提高+5.3到+20.0个准确率点；在MATH-500上，当早期预测与目标能力对齐时提高7.0-13.5点，否则下降；在StrategyQA上比开环提高5.0-8.3点。
analysis.limitations: 在MATH-500上，若早期预测与目标能力不匹配则性能下降；触发时机存在权衡，早期调用证据弱，晚期调用纠正能力差。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出轨迹触发的稀疏协作解码，利用草稿模型生成路径的轨迹形状特征构建触发策略，在需要时调用目标模型进行校正，从而在保持或提升准确率的同时降低目标模型计算量。
analysis.method: 使用逻辑回归分类器基于草稿置信度路径的轨迹形状特征（而非局部不确定性）预测何时调用目标模型进行校正，在线使用该触发策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究稀疏协作解码中触发目标模型进行校正的策略，通过轨迹形状特征预测是否调用目标模型，以减少目标模型计算并提升解码质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系，本文专注于通用语言模型的稀疏协作解码方法，不涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人任务，但其效率优化思想可能为未来VLA/WAM的高效推理提供借鉴。

Triggers use the evolving confidence trajectory rather than fixed schedules or local uncertainty spikes. Early calls have higher leverage but weaker evidence; later calls have less leverage.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable language-guided robot manipulation, but remain vulnerable to visual attacks that undermine user control over robot behavior. Prior studies optimize visual perturbations using fixed target supervision. However, the perturbation can change earlier actions and, in turn, the physical states reached later. As the attacked trajectory evolves, this supervision may no longer match the behavior needed at the states actually reached. Accurately matching these targets can therefore fail to advance the attacker-specified task. Even with suitable supervision, reducing average matching error does not ensure sustained task progress. The robot may still fail at a critical stage, and further updates can disrupt previously successful behavior. To address these limitations, we propose TRACO, a framework that enhances existing targeted visual attacks through closed-loop optimization. Its Execution-Driven Supervision rebuilds supervision for the states reached under attack to guide subsequent updates. Within this framework, Progress-Guided Selection focuses updates where progress stalls while maintaining supervision on the earlier behavior needed to reach that point. Experiments across VLA models and simulation environments show improved task-redirection success with TRACO, highlighting the security implications of closed-loop attack optimization.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明TRACO在多个VLA模型和仿真环境中提高了任务重定向成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TRACO框架，通过执行驱动监督和进展引导选择解决现有视觉攻击中监督失效和任务进展不稳定的问题。
analysis.method: 闭环优化，包括执行驱动监督（重建攻击下实际到达状态的监督信号）和进展引导选择（聚焦于进展停滞阶段的更新）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TRACO框架，通过闭环优化增强针对VLA模型的视觉任务重定向攻击。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的安全性，研究视觉攻击下的机器人操作行为，与VLA主题高度相关。虽不涉及WAM，但涉及VLA模型的策略学习、机器人操作和视觉-语言方面，对本站VLA主题具有明确的关联性。

papers.abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.

analysis.key_results: M3-Agent在MIST揭示分数上比基线提升超过三倍；在WRBench的T分数上提升26.1%，在MBench-T的U分数上提升52.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MIST评估基准以分离场景设置与指令变更，定位视频世界模型的记忆瓶颈，并开发M3-Agent递归修正输入指令以提升模型执行能力。
analysis.method: MIST评估将变更隐藏于场景设置阶段，后期再要求展示，控制泄露；M3-Agent通过递归修正指令细节，使模型成功执行请求。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了MIST评估基准和M3-Agent方法，通过将指令执行与记忆解耦，揭示了视频世界模型在未执行变更时记忆测试失效的问题，并显著提升了模型在多个基准上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视频世界模型（WAM）的记忆与指令执行瓶颈，提出评估与改进方法，与本站的世界模型主题高度相关，但不涉及机器人动作预测或VLA。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, gives the agent a thin harness: one command line that turns its commands into robot motion and makes no decisions of its own. On the robot, the agent keeps doing what it does best: it reads output, writes code and runs tests. Two agents of the same model share the work. An acting agent runs each episode. After a failure, an optimizer agent reads the full record of the episode, with every command, image and message, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools, each with its own tests. What the agents learn stays as code, and no demonstrations or training are needed. At run time, the tools use only what a real robot also has: RGB images, camera calibration and the state of the arms. They find objects by triangulation between camera views. Because these inputs are the same in simulation and on hardware, the tools move to a real robot with a different arm after only a small change for the arm. We build the tools on ten layouts of one seed per task with Codex and GPT-6-Astra and freeze them; the eight Open tasks share one set of tools. In RoboDojo's official evaluation on a hidden seed, 50 episodes for each of the 42 tasks, HexaShell reaches 46.9% success and a progress score of 53.2, the state of the art on the official RoboDojo leaderboard. The limit is contact, not reasoning: memory tasks reach 81.0%, but precision tasks only 32.0%. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo官方评测中，42个任务各50轮，达到46.9%成功率和53.2进度分，为官方排行榜最优；记忆类任务成功率81.0%，精密类任务仅32.0%。
analysis.limitations: 性能瓶颈在接触操作而非推理；精密操作任务成功率较低（32.0%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HexaShell，一个将VLM转用于机器人控制的薄型接口，通过让代理编写代码工具实现跨仿真到真机的泛化，并在RoboDojo基准上取得最优成绩。
analysis.method: 使用两个VLM代理分工：一个执行，一个优化；代理通过命令行接口控制机器人，通过三角测量定位物体，并编写带测试的工具；工具在仿真和硬件上共享，迁移到不同机械臂只需小改。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出HexaShell，一个薄型接口，让VLM代理直接控制机器人并通过角色分工和工具学习在仿真与真实间迁移，在RoboDojo排行榜上取得最优成绩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向VLA（视觉-语言-动作）智能体在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出以代码作为策略表示的新方法；虽然不显式构建世界模型或动作世界模型，但其工具学习和跨仿真-真实迁移的方法对机器人学习策略有直接价值，可视为一种替代传统VLA行为克隆的途径。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo的42个任务上成功率达到39.7%，进度分数48.0（按排行榜方式平均），为新的最先进水平；推动任务92.5%，记忆任务65.0%，紧密插入仅8.3%。
analysis.limitations: 接触而非推理是主要限制：紧密插入任务成功率极低（8.3%），失败时通常能感知到失败但无法通过运动解决。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出薄壳系统HexaShell，使VLM智能体通过编写和修复工具代码来自主操控机器人，并在RoboDojo基准上取得新SOTA，同时分析其能力极限。
analysis.method: 利用VLM编码智能体（Codex with GPT-6-Astra）通过命令行接收三个RGB摄像头和标定信息，失败后读取日志并编写/修复工具程序；工具使用三角测量和平面射线求交定位物体，可移动腕部摄像头获取第二视角；先在10个布局上构建工具，再冻结并在10个新布局上测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过让VLM智能体以编码方式控制双臂机器人，在RoboDojo任务上实现新的最先进成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接涉及视觉语言模型（VLA）在机器人操作中的应用，探索了VLM智能体作为机器人编码智能体的可能性，对VLA研究和机器人操作具有核心参考价值。

papers.abstract: Lithography process drift can move a fabricated pattern outside its process window, producing unqualified scanning electron microscopy (SEM) morphology. We present LithoWorld, an endpoint world model for SEM-guided parameter recovery. Interior representative targets jointly determine qualified reference appearance and correction supervision. A causal predictive branch aligns currentimage features with endpoint representations, while a conditional flow policy generates a two-dimensional correction as an action chunk. The model learns from 173 groups of measured SEMs organized as focus-exposure maps, preserving unmeasured cells as unknown. On 200 test pairs from the 73-group subset, LithoWorld achieves 88.5% qualified-region success and 46.0% interior success, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 2.5 and 6.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablations separate the effects of target selection, endpoint alignment, and output parameterization. Qualitative SEM retrieval illustrates recovery to qualified interiors without requiring exact reference-coordinate matching.

analysis.key_results: 在73组子集的200个测试对上，合格区域成功率为88.5%，内部成功率为46.0%，分别比最强对比方法高2.5和6.0个百分点；消融实验分离了目标选择、端点对齐和输出参数化的作用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LithoWorld端点世界模型，结合代表性目标、因果预测分支和条件流策略，实现SEM引导的参数恢复。
analysis.method: 利用端点世界模型、因果预测分支对齐当前图像特征与端点表示，条件流策略生成二维校正动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LithoWorld，一个基于端点表示的世界模型，通过SEM图像指导光刻工艺窗口参数恢复。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于领域特定的世界模型，应用于光刻工艺，不涉及机器人动作预测或通用世界模型，与VLA/WAM主题无直接关系，但所提出的端点表示和条件生成机制可能对世界建模方法有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Rapid progress in embodied intelligence has enabled increasingly capable robots to follow language instructions and manipulate diverse objects. However, strong results in structured environments do not automatically transfer to open-world conditions, where clutter, occlusion, and changing viewpoints can obscure the spatial relationships required for action. To address this perceptual gap, a virtual active-perception paradigm is introduced. AWAM, an Active World-Action Model actively plans where to observe and imagines what will be seen along the planned trajectory before acting. Task-related virtual camera motion is predicted and used as a structured query into a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior for manipulation, which is later compressed into a fixed memory and fused with live observations through cross-attention for diffusion-based action prediction. AWAM achieves competitive success rates with 75.9% on LIBERO-Occ, 62.4% on LIBERO-Plus, 76.5% on RLBench-OG Occlusion1, and 94.4% in real-robot trials. These results support improved robustness to the evaluated occlusions and distribution shifts, addressing part of the gap between structured manipulation and less controlled environments.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Occ上成功率达75.9%，LIBERO-Plus上62.4%，RLBench-OG Occlusion1上76.5%，真实机器人试验94.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入虚拟主动感知范式，设计主动世界-动作模型AWAM，主动规划观察轨迹并想象未来视图，生成可复用的空间先验用于扩散策略动作预测。
analysis.method: 预测任务相关的虚拟相机运动，将其作为几何条件世界模型的结构化查询，生成空间先验并压缩为固定记忆，再与实时观测通过交叉注意力融合，用于扩散策略的动作预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出主动世界-动作模型AWAM，通过主动规划观察视角并想象未来视图，构建空间先验以增强遮挡和分布偏移下的机器人操作鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心贡献是主动世界-动作模型（WAM），通过主动视角想象提前构建空间先验，与动作预测结合，直接提升遮挡和分布偏移下的操作鲁棒性，属于WAM在机器人操作中的直接应用。

papers.abstract: Robots manipulating objects in clutter must decide not only how to act, but also where to look. Although active camera motion can expose an occluded target, it may move the robot into an initial observation-state distribution that differs from the manipulation policy's training distribution. We identify this problem as first-frame distribution sensitivity: under perturbed starts in LIBERO, naively prepending camera repositioning to pi_0.5 reduces success from 46.3% to 11.5%. We introduce ActiveAlign, a data-adaptation framework that trains a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy from the states at which active perception terminates. A learned viewpoint module first generates a camera trajectory. Offline, ActiveAlign uses closed-loop alignment to connect the trajectory endpoint to an existing demonstration, replays the remaining manipulation trajectory, and retains successful continuations for fine-tuning. At deployment, the same viewpoint module precedes the adapted VLA without modifying its architecture. Across 40 LIBERO tasks, ActiveAlign achieves 70.7% success with pi_0 and 72.7% with pi_0.5, outperforming their standard-training baselines by 40.0% and 26.4% respectively. Matched-state and data-matched controls support gains beyond prefix shortening and generic viewpoint augmentation; OpenVLA and GR00T N1 also show the same trend. Success rate under physical occlusion in real world increases from 35/90 to 83/90. These results show that active perception benefits manipulation when policy training is aligned with the observation and robot-state distribution induced by viewpoint selection.

analysis.key_results: 在 40 个 LIBERO 任务上，pi_0 成功率 70.7%，pi_0.5 成功率 72.7%，分别比标准训练基线高 40.0% 和 26.4%；真实世界物理遮挡下从 35/90 提升到 83/90。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别首帧分布敏感性，并引入 ActiveAlign 数据适配框架，在 VLA 训练中考虑主动感知的末端状态。
analysis.method: 学习视角模块生成相机轨迹，使用闭环对齐连接轨迹端点与现有演示，重放后续操控轨迹并保留成功延续进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 ActiveAlign 框架，使 VLA 策略与主动感知产生的观察状态分布对齐，从而提升杂乱环境中的操控成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于 VLA 策略与主动感知的集成，属于本站 VLA 主题的核心研究，对机器人操作与效率有实际意义。

papers.abstract: When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit? (2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.

analysis.key_results: 跨情节实验中，单位最后一位干预改变了11.9%的种子配对结果；完整记忆配置将任务成功率从39.1%提升至74.3%，与共享记录执行下的预言决策条件相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种干预性记忆评估协议（IMEP），用于评估视觉-语言-动作系统中记忆的净收益、帮助条件、任务结果变化和任务相关事实特异性。
analysis.method: 在检索界面比较目标事实替换、事实保留替换、最小数值扰动和精确复制，并分离决策正确性和运动执行成功；同时引入ChainBench基准，要求基于历史信息做出正确决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种干预性评估协议，用于检验视觉-语言-动作系统中记忆是否真正提供了任务相关的益处。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统中的记忆评估，提出超越成功率的方法论和基准，对VLA系统的可靠性和可解释性具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Modern deep learning systems increasingly rely on high-dimensional vector operations, in which large input and parameter vectors are repeatedly stored, transferred, and processed. Although substantial research has focused on reducing neural-network model size through pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architectures, the storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs associated with repeatedly presented high-dimensional input vectors remain important practical considerations, particularly in distributed and edge-computing environments. This paper proposes the SETAREH (Sorting-assisted Energy-concentrating Transform for Approximate Representation using Haar wavelets) transform, a Haar-wavelet-based sparsification approach for approximating the inner product between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors. By applying the same sequence of permutations and Haar transforms to both vectors, SETAREH preserves the exact inner product before truncation. It then retains only a subset of the transformed coefficient-input pairs, reducing their representation cost while introducing a controllable approximation error. To evaluate SETAREH, we consider two complementary experimental settings: a synthetic Gaussian-vector baseline and a real apparent-age estimation task using a convolutional neural network on the APPA-REAL dataset. The results show that SETAREH can approximate the evaluated inner products using substantially fewer transformed coefficient-input pairs than the original vector dimension. The findings support its use as a potential structured data-representation method for repeated inner products with fixed weights, while the practical benefit depends on approximation accuracy and the cost of storing or transmitting permutation metadata.

analysis.key_results: 在合成高斯向量基线和APPA-REAL年龄估计任务上，SETAREH可以用远少于原始维度的变换对近似内积。
analysis.limitations: 实际收益取决于近似精度和存储/传输排列元数据的成本。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SETAREH变换，一种基于Haar小波的稀疏化方法，用于近似固定权重向量与输入向量的内积，同时保留截断前的精确内积并引入可控误差。
analysis.method: 对两个向量应用相同的排列和Haar变换序列，保留变换后系数-输入对的子集以降低表示成本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SETAREH变换，利用Haar小波稀疏化近似高维向量内积，减少存储和通信成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究高效内积近似，属于独立的高效推理/量化技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但对VLA/WAM中重复的固定权重向量运算可能有潜在应用价值。

papers.abstract: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

analysis.key_results: LAW在50个RoboTwin任务上平均成功率为94.21%，替换为OpenWAM-α后达95.56%；仅2B参数的VLM优于Embodied-R1.5和GPT-5.5 High变体；在三个真实机器人长程任务上平均成功率为65%，对比π0.5为28.33%、Fast-WAM为25%。

analysis.method: 采用混合专家VLM规划剩余子任务、评估并融合世界-动作模型的动作；世界-动作模型中使用Mixture-of-Transformer Experts进行联合视频-动作建模；采用双流层次化视觉记忆和子任务局部价值学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LAW提出一个闭环VLM-WAM框架，在语义子任务进度引导下统一语言推理、动作生成与世界建模，实现长程机器人操作。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon robotic tasks expose a fundamental limitation of current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models because their restricted temporal context pre-vents effective accumulation and reuse of past experiences. As a result, memory has become a fundamental component for enabling embodied agents to perform long-horizon reasoning and adaptive decision-making. This survey presents a systematic taxonomy of VLA memory mechanisms based on memory scope and persistence, categorizing existing approaches into five representative paradigms and one emerging frontier. Based on this taxonomy, we compare representative VLA memory systems in terms of memory characteristics, architectural com-plexity, and open-source maturity, revealing a clear trade-off in which increasing architectural complexity is generally accompanied by decreasing open-source ma-turity. Finally, we discuss the key challenges in building full-lifecycle memory systems, including efficient memory management and lifelong knowledge evolu-tion. Overall, this survey provides a unified perspective on memory architectures for VLA agents and offers insights into the development of lifelong embodied in-telligence.

analysis.key_results: 揭示架构复杂性与开源成熟度之间的权衡关系，即架构越复杂，开源成熟度通常越低。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种基于记忆范围和持续性的VLA记忆机制系统分类法，将现有方法归纳为五种代表性范式和一种新兴前沿。
analysis.method: 基于记忆范围和持续性的双重视角分类法，对代表性VLA记忆系统从记忆特征、架构复杂性和开源成熟度三个方面进行比较。

papers.abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.

analysis.key_results: 系统实验表明移动代理广泛易受多模态注入攻击影响，许多失败源于早期阶段的推理劫持。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个针对移动代理的跨模态注入攻击与推理到行动安全风险的基准MobileInject，包含高保真交互式评估框架、多种攻击方法和安全性诊断框架。
analysis.method: 构建包含11个场景、9个安全风险类别和108个可执行风险实例的评测框架，引入跨模态一致性注入、多角色协同欺骗、推理伪装注入等攻击方法，并提出推理安全诊断框架进行细粒度失败分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出MobileInject基准，用于评估基于多模态大语言模型的移动代理在面对跨模态一致性注入攻击时的推理到行动安全性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于基于多模态大语言模型的移动代理安全性评测，虽与机器人学习、VLA或WAM无直接关联，但其推理到行动安全性分析框架对具身智能体的安全评估可能具有借鉴价值。
