papers.abstract: While Assist-as-Needed (AAN) control aims to maximize user participation in robot-assisted training, existing methods relying solely on physical metrics cannot distinguish muscular inability from mental disengagement, leading to suboptimal interventions. To address this ambiguity, a Flow-theoretic multimodal AAN framework is proposed, fusing EEG-based mental engagement and sEMG-based physical engagement into an adaptive impedance control strategy. A four-quadrant fuzzy decision engine translates these dual physiological metrics into continuous control policies. This enables the upper-limb exoskeleton to inject feedforward assistance during intent-execution mismatch (e.g., motor output attenuation despite mental focus) and escalate guiding stiffness to penalize mental distraction. The framework was validated with healthy participants against a state-of-practice sEMG-only AAN baseline. Kinematically and mechanically, the proposed framework reduced robotic energy expenditure by 71.9\% while maintaining precise trajectory tracking, confirming it elicited greater voluntary human effort. Physiologically, the system increased the time spent in the neuroplasticity zone (Flow State Ratio) from 4.6% to 42.8%. These results validate that decoupling and jointly regulating mental and physical states enhances the selectivity of robotic assistance, mitigating user passivity and sustaining the engagement crucial for motor learning.

analysis.key_results: 相比仅用sEMG的基线，机器人能量消耗降低71.9%，同时保持轨迹跟踪精准；Flow State Ratio从4.6%提高到42.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Flow-theoretic多模态AAN框架，融合EEG精神投入与sEMG物理投入，通过四象限模糊决策将双重生理指标转化为连续控制策略。
analysis.method: 融合EEG和sEMG的流量理论多模态协助按需控制，采用四象限模糊决策引擎生成自适应阻抗控制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于流量理论的多模态协助按需控制框架，融合EEG心理投入和sEMG生理投入，实现上肢外骨骼的自适应阻抗控制。

papers.abstract: Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and $25/72$ safe completions, compared with $15/39$ and $20/72$ for checker-free generic feedback. Strict completion remains $17/72$; verdict accuracy changes from $47/72$ to $46/72$. The claim-grouped safe-completion difference is $.094$, with a bootstrap 95\% interval of $[.000,.198]$. All seven task-level gains follow horizon/input-length diagnostics. A post-hoc schema-only correction of the direct outputs reaches the same 25 safe tasks without another model call. These results separate claim classification from executable evidence, while locating the observed gains in witness-structure correction rather than demonstrating broader reasoning improvement.

analysis.key_results: 验证器反馈在无效命题上获得23/39的接受反例和25/72的安全补全，相比之下无检查器通用反馈为15/39和20/72；严格补全仍为17/72；判决准确率从47/72变为46/72。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入ClaimScope基准，用于审计数学命题，并提供一种通过见证检查器反馈改进模型生成的方法。
analysis.method: 使用Qwen3-8B直接生成，并比较四种双阶段条件（均从同一草稿开始）下的表现，通过一个见证检查器仅评估模型提交的状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一个用于数学命题审计的基准，并评估了验证反馈对模型生成证伪、修复和补全的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于数学命题审计中的验证反馈和高效推理策略，与VLA/WAM无直接关系，但对投机解码或验证器引导生成的方法论有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Specialized vision-language-action (VLA) policies acquire strong domain-specific skills, yet consolidating these skills into one shared policy remains challenging. On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on inputs induced by the student, addressing the distribution mismatch encountered during deployment. For flow-based VLAs, this mismatch arises at two levels: environment observations and intermediate action-generation states. We propose a two-level on-policy distillation framework that couples student-driven environment interaction with teacher velocity supervision along student-generated action flow trajectories. Frozen domain specialists jointly supervise one student. After each update, the student collects new environment experience and generates fresh action-flow trajectories. Starting from a joint supervised fine-tuning (SFT) initialization, Velocity Loss OPD yields absolute success-rate gains of 22.55% on LIBERO-40, 33.4% on CALVIN five-instruction sequences, and 22.6% on Meta-World MT50. Compared with Action Loss OPD and Teacher-rollout SFT, it achieves absolute success-rate gains of 6.4-9.5% on LIBERO-40, 9.7-18.3% on CALVIN, and 3.2-4.2% on Meta-World MT50. Analysis by sequence length further shows larger success-rate gains on longer CALVIN sequences. These results demonstrate effective multi-domain capability consolidation through two-level on-policy supervision, with a single student deployed across domains.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-40上绝对成功率提高22.55%，在CALVIN五指令序列上提高33.4%，在Meta-World MT50上提高22.6%；相比Action Loss OPD和Teacher-rollout SFT，在LIBERO-40上提高6.4-9.5%，在CALVIN上提高9.7-18.3%，在Meta-World MT50上提高3.2-4.2%。

analysis.method: 学生与环境在线交互收集经验，教师沿学生生成的动作流轨迹提供速度监督，使用速度损失进行在线策略蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出两级在线蒸馏框架，通过学生驱动环境交互和教师速度监督来整合多个领域专用流式VLA策略。

papers.abstract: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.

analysis.key_results: 在真实机器人和仿真中，CarryOn能在不同用户和场景间分派偏好一致的子任务，将已安全微调VLA的违规率从52.6%降至6.1%，并通过技能复用将恢复成功率从13%提高到80%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CarryOn双回路系统，通过规划回路维护用户和场景上下文实现个性化，通过执行回路进行安全监督和故障恢复，从而增强VLA策略。
analysis.method: 双回路框架：规划回路根据用户偏好和场景上下文进行个性化子任务分解，执行回路对策略输出进行安全约束并在失败时调用可复用的控制恢复技能，并通过反思不断完善技能。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CarryOn通过双回路系统增强冻结的VLA策略，实现个性化任务分解和可靠执行，包括安全防护与故障恢复。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA策略在真实世界机器人辅助中的个性化与可靠性问题，提出了增强VLA执行的双回路系统，与本站关注的VLA和机器人操作主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. Flow-GRPO then jointly refines the chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy from same-task closed-loop outcomes, supplemented by outcome-verified stopping supervision. With eight controls per decision, X-Fly reaches 74.18% SR on test-seen and 51.73% on test-unseen, compared with 16.45% and 18.43% for full-chunk BC and 32.04% and 29.46% for DreamFly.

analysis.key_results: 在 OpenFly 测试集上，X-Fly 达到 test-seen 74.18% SR、test-unseen 51.73% SR，而全块式 BC 分别为 16.45% 和 18.43%，DreamFly 分别为 32.04% 和 29.46%；模型推理从 195 ms 降至每执行航点 42 ms。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 X-Fly 分阶段训练框架，包含 Recovery DAgger 和 Flow-GRPO，用于训练全块式空中 VLN 策略，使其能到达目标区域并正确停止。
analysis.method: Recovery DAgger 在决策状态标注平滑块以重新连接未来专家轨迹段，并在首个区域内状态标注 STOP；Flow-GRPO 从同任务闭环结果联合优化分块流控制器与 Bernoulli STOP 策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: X-Fly 是一个分阶段训练框架，旨在解决全块式空中视觉语言导航中模型查询昂贵、无停止失败和恢复监督缺失的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究涉及基于大型视觉语言模型的空中视觉语言导航，属于 VLA 范畴，但其方法重点在于通过预测完整动作块来降低模型推理成本，并在决策状态上进行恢复监督，对本站在高效推理与 VLA 结合方面的研究具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which runs the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head on the device to build a deep chain and uses one SLM pass to add alternative branches. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An {\epsilon}-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three runs of each system on Spec-Bench show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-{\epsilon}. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

analysis.key_results: 在Galaxy S26 Ultra上，相比服务器端MTP自推测，HyCo在Spec-Bench上减少38.6%的GPU时间，在32K摘要上减少29.2%；与SLM-only草稿相比，节省多9.0个百分点，交付速度1.9倍；与Cloud+MTP的裁判评分差为+0.2（95% CI: -0.9至+1.3）；无松弛时节省分别为27.7%和11.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HyCo混合草稿生成框架，利用设备上的服务器模型MTP头与小型语言模型协同构建深层草稿树，减少移动NPU上的重复推理，提高推测解码效率。
analysis.method: 服务器返回隐藏状态、输入嵌入和键值对以支持设备端MTP头；使用量化、受限词汇表和1K令牌窗口适配移动NPU；引入ε阈值规则放宽对验证器采样分布的精确保持。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HyCo通过将服务器模型的多令牌预测头部署到设备端并结合小型语言模型单次推理，实现移动-云推测解码的深度链与分支构建，从而降低服务器计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通用推测解码的效率优化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但与本站关注的模型效率主题（推测解码、量化）有交集，可为其在机器人推理中的潜在应用提供方法参考。

We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An {\epsilon}-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three Spec-Bench runs per system show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-{\epsilon}. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate action sequences that reduce repeated inference, but deciding how much of each sequence to execute is critical to task success. Existing adaptive methods make this decision using generation stability or prediction agreement, yet these signals do not establish whether executing a candidate prefix preserves the ability to complete the task. We introduce a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that anticipates the consequences of candidate action prefixes and evaluates their compatibility with successful continuation before execution. Rather than using future prediction to generate actions, our method evaluates existing proposals in the VLA's internal task-conditioned representation space. To learn local judgments from terminal task outcomes, we combine trajectory-level survival supervision with a localization prior that preserves useful behavior within failed rollouts. The resulting validity scores guide execution-horizon selection. Evaluations with pi_0 and pi_0.5 across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation show improved success-query trade-offs. These findings point toward a different role for future prediction in robotics, using it to assess how far to trust a policy's proposed actions rather than to generate new ones.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作中，使用pi_0和pi_0.5评估，显示改进的成功-查询权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入策略对齐预测验证器（PAV），利用VLA内部任务条件表示空间中的未来预测来评估候选动作前缀的兼容性，从而指导自适应动作块执行长度选择。
analysis.method: 在VLA内部表示空间中对候选动作前缀进行未来预测，结合轨迹级生存监督和局部化先验来学习局部判断，并使用得到的有效性分数指导执行长度选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种策略对齐的预测验证器，在VLA内部表示空间中评估候选动作前缀，以决定执行多少动作块，从而提升任务成功率与查询效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA策略的自适应动作块执行问题，通过预测验证提高推理效率，属于VLA高效执行与动作选择的研究，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) systems provide high-bandwidth, spatially secure, and RF-interference-free digital transmission. However, direct free-space optical links suffer from extreme sensitivity to line-of-sight disruptions, optical attenuation, high ambient light saturation, and transmitter-receiver misalignment. Traditional channel diagnostic frameworks rely on external computing nodes or cloud-based processing, which introduces severe diagnostic latency and reduces edge node autonomy. This paper presents an autonomous, self-diagnosing optical wireless receiver node that integrates physical-layer signal telemetry extraction with an on-device TinyML classification engine. Built around an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, the receiver recovers 1000 bit/s On-Off Keying (OOK) digital payloads using a 5-sample majority voting mechanism while concurrently extracting real-time channel features: Bit Error Rate (BER), received signal voltage (Vsignal), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNRdB), and ambient light baseline (Lambient). Evaluated against a Random Forest baseline (77.22% accuracy) and a floating-point neural network (78.48% accuracy), a post-training INT8 quantized TensorFlow Lite Micro model occupying only 3.32 kB of SRAM runs directly on the receiver firmware. The quantized model achieves 74.68% overall accuracy across four distinct operational conditions: normal transmission, optical filter attenuation, ambient light interference, and severe obstruction/misalignment. On-device deployment tests confirm real-time, deterministic fault classification, establishing a practical approach for self-aware optical IoT nodes.

analysis.key_results: 量化模型在四种工况下达到74.68%准确率，模型仅占用3.32 kB SRAM，且部署测试确认实时确定性故障分类。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种在光无线通信接收节点上集成物理层信号遥测与片上TinyML分类引擎的自主故障诊断方法，通过后训练INT8量化模型实现实时边缘诊断。
analysis.method: 基于ESP32-S3微控制器，提取BER、信号电压、SNR和背景光等信道特征，使用INT8量化的TensorFlow Lite Micro模型进行分类。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 设计了一种集成TinyML的自诊断光无线接收节点，利用INT8量化模型在MCU上实时分类信道故障。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于无线光通信的量化边缘推理，未涉及VLA或WAM，但与本站效率推理主题相关，展示了模型量化在资源受限嵌入式设备上的应用。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly place a multi-billion-parameter model inside the feedback loop, repeatedly recomputing task context whenever they predict a new action chunk. Yet task understanding changes far more slowly than the robot state. We introduce Fast-VLA, which invokes a frozen 4B VLM once per episode to contextualize the instruction and initial views as fixed, multi-layer key-value task memory. During execution, a lightweight online actor fuses learned time- and arm-indexed queries with current visual and proprioceptive feedback to form action queries. These queries retrieve task context from the fixed memory and predict action chunks without re-running the foundation model. Fast-VLA achieves 92.46% and 92.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean and Randomized, and 95.95% and 79.11% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus evaluation. Against three continually conditioned baselines on the same hardware, it reduces RoboTwin amortized policy inference time by 10.9-17.1x and requires 1.22 GiB of post-prefill online resident memory. Task-memory swaps further show that the actor relies on episode-matched task memory. These results show that task context can be established once while closed-loop control remains responsive throughout execution. Project page: https://garfield-kh.github.io/FastVLA

analysis.key_results: RoboTwin 2.0 Clean和Randomized成功率分别为92.46%和92.40%；LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus评估成功率分别为95.95%和79.11%；与同样硬件上的三个连续条件基线相比，RoboTwin平均策略推理时间减少10.9-17.1倍，预填充后在线常驻内存仅1.22 GiB；任务记忆交换实验表明actor依赖回合匹配的任务记忆。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Fast-VLA，将VLA中的大型VLM从控制环路中解耦，固定为任务记忆，并用轻量在线actor实现高效动作预测。
analysis.method: 每回合调用一次冻结的4B VLM，将指令和初始视图编码为多层键值任务记忆；执行过程中轻量在线actor利用时间/手臂索引查询和当前视觉、本体感觉反馈，从固定记忆中检索上下文并预测动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Fast-VLA通过每回合仅调用一次大型VLM建立固定任务记忆，由轻量在线actor在控制环路中预测动作块，从而大幅提升VLA策略的推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA策略的高效推理问题，属于VLA与高效推理的交叉，核心贡献在于减少控制环路中大型视觉语言模型的计算量。

papers.abstract: Safe autonomous navigation using monocular vision remains challenging because explicit obstacle states are not directly observable. This letter introduces a visual safety-certification paradigm that uses scale-free, depth-normalized relative motion encoded by monocular optical flow as the representation for collision-risk certification, without reconstructing obstacle position, velocity, geometry, or a metric world model. Unlike conventional optical-flow-based navigation approaches that rely on image motion to shape avoidance behavior, the proposed framework directly encodes collision-cone geometry and safety constraints in this relative-motion representation. An online Concurrent Learning observer estimates the normalized relative velocity and provides a computable estimation-error bound. This uncertainty is propagated into the collision cone through angular inflation and a monocular robot-footprint margin, yielding a Robust Vision-Based Collision Cone Control Barrier Function (RV-C$^3$BF). An optimal-decay CBF quadratic program minimally modifies the nominal control input to enforce the resulting robust safety constraint under the stated assumptions. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on a TurtleBot3 in cluttered environments with static and dynamic obstacles demonstrate collision avoidance using only monocular vision and onboard proprioception, with the estimation-error bound containing the measured error in $98.3\%$ of simulation samples and the robot achieving collision-free navigation in $93$ of $100$ real-world trials.

analysis.key_results: 仿真中估计误差界在98.3%的样本中包含测量误差，真实世界100次试验中93次实现无碰撞导航。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种基于尺度无关相对运动的视觉安全认证范式，无需重建障碍物状态或度量世界模型，通过单目光流直接编码碰撞锥几何与安全约束。
analysis.method: 使用单目光流作为尺度无关相对运动表示，结合在线并发学习观测器估计归一化相对速度，并通过角度膨胀和单目机器人足迹边缘将估计误差传播到碰撞锥中，构建鲁棒视觉碰撞锥控制屏障函数（RV-C3BF），最终通过最优衰减CBF二次规划最小修改标称控制输入。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种基于单目光流的视觉安全认证框架，通过尺度无关相对运动表示实现无显式障碍物状态估计的碰撞风险认证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主要关注基于视觉的导航安全认证，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界-动作模型（WAM）的直接应用。但其利用单目视觉和相对运动表示进行环境交互与安全约束的方法，可为机器人策略学习中的安全约束设计提供方法论参考，与本站主题存在一定的间接关联。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $\pi_{0.5}$ as LTM-$\pi$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$\pi$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. Scaling RoboMME demonstrations tenfold improves success from 57.67% to 87.50%, while a Cup Swap diagnostic highlights the role of process supervision in temporal composition. Under a 200-token memory budget, success remains 84.00%, versus 87.50% without compression. Finally, real-robot counting success improves from 11.25% to 82.50%. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency of latent transition memory, highlighting its capacity for complex temporal information, bounded-context operation, and real-world robotic control.

analysis.key_results: LTM-π 在 RoboMME 上成功率为 58.54%，在 LIBERO-Mem 上为 80.5%，在无外部推理模型或记忆特定标注的基线中表现最佳；将 RoboMME 演示扩展十倍后成功率从 57.67% 提升至 87.50%；在 200-token 记忆预算下成功率保持在 84.00%；真实机器人计数任务成功率从 11.25% 提升至 82.50%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 Latent Transition Memory (LTM)，将历史以潜在转移形式存储，并实例化为 LTM-π，在 VLA 模型上实现增量推理，无需记忆特定语义标注或外部推理模型调用。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的潜在动作编码器、轻量适配器和因果 KV 缓存进行增量推理；利用 DreamDojo 转移数据训练；采用延迟记忆接纳机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出潜在转移记忆（LTM），将历史存储为连续观测之间的紧凑潜在转移，实现视觉-语言-动作模型的高效上下文记忆。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，提出一种内存机制以捕捉时序交互和不可见状态，属于 VLA 范畴的高效推理和上下文记忆方法，对机器人操作中的长期记忆与策略学习具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. However, exhaustive search computes every distance at full precision, whereas approximate indexes return recall below one. We observe that exact search only needs a proof that each excluded vector cannot be a neighbor. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. We call this principle certified exclusion and realize it in an exact kNN method for GPUs, which we call CertEx. Specifically, CertEx stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that CertEx returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, CertEx is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 (8.8$\times$ to 11.8$\times$ on an A100) and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.

analysis.key_results: 在 16 个数据集（最大 1 亿向量）上，CertEx 对所有查询均精确，吞吐量是 H100 上最快 cuVS 的 7.1 倍至 18.0 倍（A100 上为 8.8 倍至 11.8 倍），并在所有查询必须精确时优于量化索引和图索引。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出认证排除（certified exclusion）原则，并在 GPU 上实现精确 kNN 方法 CertEx，保证查询精确性的同时大幅提升检索速度。
analysis.method: 将每个向量的下界投影以半精度存储，并在同一个张量核心点积中融入舍入证书，仅对通过测试的少数向量计算精确距离。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CertEx 通过认证排除机制，在 GPU 上半精度存储下界投影并利用张量核心点积实现大规模精确 kNN 检索，显著提升吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大规模图像描述符和嵌入的精确 kNN 检索，通过低精度下界存储和认证排除来加速推理，属于模型量化与高效推理技术。该技术可潜在用于 VLA/WAM 中的嵌入索引或记忆检索，但论文未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，因此无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Predicting cost in a multi-agent world model moves most constrained policy updates into imagination: the stronger model-free baseline needs $10$ to $20$ times CA-MAMBA's interactions on the median SMAC configuration, and CA-MAMBA earns $2.8$ to $12$ times the baselines' MAMuJoCo reward at equal budget. In controlled tests on one task per benchmark, pricing the model's cost advantages at parity more than halves a cost-blind learner's cost and meets a tight continuous-control limit the learned multiplier misses, suggesting the model's cost estimates are not the bottleneck.

analysis.key_results: 在SMAC中，CA-MAMBA仅需基线10到20分之一的交互；在MAMuJoCo中，相同预算下获得2.8到12倍基线奖励；成本平价时使成本盲学习器成本减半。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CA-MAMBA，利用多智能体世界模型在想象中进行受限策略更新，大幅提升样本效率并实现卓越的奖励表现。
analysis.method: 多智能体世界模型中的成本预测，将受限策略更新移至想象中；采用成本感知的模型基方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种多智能体世界模型方法，通过成本预测与想象中策略更新，显著提升样本效率和约束满足能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于多智能体强化学习中的世界模型，与机器人动作预测或视觉-语言-动作模型无直接关系，但对世界建模方法具有间接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-$\Delta$, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-$\Delta$ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和RoboTwin上达到与最先进方法竞争的性能，并在真实机器人实验中优于π0.5。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA-Δ通用框架，将物理状态变化作为显式学习目标，并构建大规模预训练数据集，提供任务相关语义和视觉运动变化的物理状态转移标注。
analysis.method: 通过从当前与未来状态的物理变化中派生监督信号，显式监督物理状态转移，并在推理时直接从当前观测生成动作，无额外推理开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出VLA-Δ框架，利用当前与未来状态之间的物理变化作为显式学习目标，以增强VLA模型的连续动作生成能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用物理状态转移监督提升动作生成，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bitwidths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weight calibration via approximate-grid quantization, yielding a processing element (PE) with significantly fewer gates than a 4-bit integer multiplier. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weight and activation quantization, FPoT improves zero-shot commonsense reasoning performance by 8.72% relative to the PoT baseline, while maintaining performance close to the uniform integer baseline, with only a negligible 0.4%p degradation. These results hold across various configurations spanning seven models and three bit-widths. Furthermore, FPoT can be integrated with state-of-the-art LLM PTQ methods, demonstrating framework-agnostic applicability.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama-3-8B上，4位权重和激活量化下，FPoT相比PoT基线在零样本常识推理上相对提升8.72%，与均匀整数基线性能接近，仅有0.4个百分点退化；结果在七个模型和三种位宽配置中保持一致。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出分数二幂（FPoT）量化方法，使用基为√2的网格，结合校准时间网格对齐优化和轻量级1加法器√2近似，实现接近均匀整数量化的性能，同时保持无乘法器的移位加法数据通路。
analysis.method: FPoT使用基为√2的权重网格与均匀整数激活，校准时的网格对齐细化被吸收到静态逐通道缩放中，并通过近似网格量化吸收1加法器√2近似的误差，从而构建出比4位整数乘法器更少门数的处理单元。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出分数二幂（FPoT）量化，采用基为√2的网格，在保持整数移位加法数据通路的同时实现4位权重量化，提升无乘法器LLM推理的效率与精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM的无乘法器量化推理，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但其量化技术可潜在地应用于高效部署VLA模型。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.

analysis.key_results: How级指令不能提高当前VLA的任务成功率，甚至会降低成功率；分段级丰富指令训练可使动作对How级指令产生响应，但不能持续提高任务成功率，且这种响应不能泛化到苛刻或分布外的How级指令。
analysis.limitations: How级指令遵循仍是一个开放性挑战，所获得的响应能力无法扩展到要求严格或分布外的How级指令。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并系统诊断了VLA模型在How级指令遵循上的不足，并创建了新的评估基准SIMPLER-IN，用于衡量模型对How级指令的遵循能力。
analysis.method: 通过诊断实验发现当前VLA模型对How级指令不敏感，提出使用分段级丰富指令进行训练以增强对How级指令的响应，并通过SIMPLER-IN基准进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文诊断并评估了视觉-语言-动作模型在How级指令（描述如何执行任务）上的遵循能力，发现当前模型无法有效响应此类指令。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接以视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）为研究对象，专注于其指令遵循能力，特别是How级指令，对VLA的评估与训练方法改进具有重要意义。

papers.abstract: General-purpose dexterous manipulation requires policies to transfer knowledge from related tasks to new tasks with only a few target demonstrations. Existing benchmarks often provide too many target demonstrations. They also leave the differences between source and target tasks uncontrolled. As a result, they cannot clearly distinguish knowledge transfer from task memorization. Our key insight is the Core-Gen principle. Core tasks are related tasks that share a functional interaction and provide source knowledge, while a Gen task is a novel target within the same functional family that has only a few demonstrations. This setup tests whether a policy can reuse functional interaction knowledge. Based on this principle, we propose Evo-DexBench, which controls both source-task relatedness and target-task exposure. It comprises 30 tasks in six functional families and a VR teleoperation pipeline. The resulting dataset covers three everyday scenes per task. It contains 1,248 multimodal demonstrations collected with simulated Shadow Hands equipped with 123 taxels. Experiments show that even the best-performing method achieves an average success rate of only 38.5%, highlighting the challenges existing methods face in transferring functional interaction knowledge. Further analysis shows that, across the two tasks, joint Core+Gen training improves performance by 12% and 38%, respectively, over training on Core followed by fine-tuning on Gen. This indicates that joint training makes better use of Core knowledge and that functionally matched Core data yields greater gains in success rate than mismatched data. We release the Evo-DexBench dataset and benchmark to support the evaluation of dexterous manipulation policies' generalization across related tasks.

analysis.key_results: 最佳方法平均成功率仅为38.5%；两项任务中Core+Gen联合训练相比Core后微调分别提升12%和38%；功能匹配的Core数据比不匹配数据带来更大提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Core-Gen原则和Evo-DexBench基准，通过控制源任务相关性和目标任务演示数量，清晰区分知识迁移与任务记忆。
analysis.method: 构建包含6个功能家族、30个任务、每任务3个日常场景的基准，使用带123个触觉传感器的Shadow Hands收集1248个多模态演示，并通过VR遥操作流水线采集数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Evo-DexBench基准，控制源任务相关性和目标任务暴露度，以评估灵巧操作策略在相关任务间的知识迁移能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准面向灵巧操作策略的知识迁移能力评估，与机器人操作学习相关，但未明确涉及VLA或世界模型。

papers.abstract: Dual-system vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a high-frequency fast policy with a slow, expensive module, and published trigger mechanisms for invoking it lack a shared objective, measured costs, and any standard separating schedule quality from module quality. We provide the missing account: invocation is formalized as a calibrated decision problem whose fixed-ratio, fixed-budget, and history-gated schedules are degenerate cases of one quantity, the Value of Intervention (VoI); a renewal baseline proves the optimal schedule periodic under state-independent collapse, with adaptive gains governed by the cost ratio $\rho$ and the dispersion of collapse. Measured systems span three orders of magnitude in $\rho$ (FiS-VLA $0.95$; RoboICL about $10^3$), and a direct test confirms the low-$\rho$ prediction: calibrated gains vanish under homogeneous collapse and grow with heterogeneity. Fourteen closed-loop arms on LIBERO test the contested middle of the continuum ($\rho=1.53$): the adaptive trigger allocates its queries exactly as the threshold rule predicts, yet the language-rewrite channel cannot convert them into success on either suite, and a revert actuator that undoes a failed rewrite is the only intervention with zero net downside on both LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Goal, where the rewrite deficit deepens from thirteen to forty-two points. A four-measure leak-free protocol cuts apparent early-warning AUC from $0.93$ to $0.62$ on $929$ deployment traces, a detection-limited frontier theorem converts detection quality into a schedulability statement, and a compilation loop turns measured value functions into per-task refresh periods within $2.4\%$ of the closed-loop oracle. Together these results turn slow-module invocation from a design opinion into a measured decision.

analysis.key_results: 低ρ预测得到验证：校准增益在同质坍缩下消失，在异质性下增长；自适应触发器分配查询与阈值规则预测一致；语言重写通道未能转化为成功，且重写缺口从13点扩大到42点；四测度防泄漏协议将早期预警AUC从0.93降至0.62；编译循环得到的刷新周期与闭环oracle相差在2.4%以内。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出将慢速模块调用形式化为校准决策问题，统一固定比例、固定预算和历史门控调度为干预价值（VoI）的特例，并提供测量标准和协议。
analysis.method: 决策论建模，VoI框架；在LIBERO上使用十四臂闭环实验验证自适应触发；编译循环根据测量价值函数确定每任务刷新周期。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 将双系统VLA中慢速模块的调用形式化为校准决策问题，引入干预价值（VoI）统一不同调度并建立测量标准。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 研究直接针对双系统VLA中慢速模块的调度问题，提出干预价值（VoI）框架和测量标准，为VLA的高效推理和策略执行提供理论依据，对VLA/WAM方向的适应性计算与资源分配具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

analysis.key_results: 在四个Unitree G1移动操作任务上，使用SONIC和HEFT两种全身控制器，在保持机器人数据不变的情况下，人类演示覆盖但机器人数据中缺失的条件下宏观平均成功率分别提升45.0和46.25个百分点；随着人类数据预算增加，该指标呈上升趋势。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出KODA方法，将人类第一视角演示转换为全身VLA训练数据，通过可重用规范轨迹引导机器人视角合成并生成控制器特定的全身状态-动作监督，支持在切换控制器时重用数据。
analysis.method: KODA使用稀疏跟踪器结合基于采样的命令优化生成经过仿真验证的全身轨迹，由轨迹确定相机位姿合成机器人视角观测，并针对每个部署控制器优化命令生成动作标签和本体感觉状态；当切换控制器时，保留规范记录重新生成监督数据进行联合训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: KODA通过可重用的规范轨迹将人类第一视角RGB演示转换成全身VLA训练数据，生成控制器特定的全身状态-动作监督，显著提升人形机器人操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对全身VLA策略训练的数据瓶颈，通过运动学-观测对齐将人类演示转换为VLA训练数据，与本站主题高度相关。

The resulting data are combined with matching real-robot demonstrations to co-train a controller-specific vision–language–action (VLA) policy for language-guided humanoid loco-manipulation.

papers.abstract: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

analysis.key_results: 学习指定动作的视觉后果可提升策略性能和跨场景泛化；动作学习可提升同一架构下多视图世界预测保真度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OneWM统一因果训练框架，证明世界建模与动作学习可以相互促进：动作条件的世界预测能提升策略性能与泛化，动作学习也能提升多视图世界预测保真度。
analysis.method: 在共享视频-动作架构中，将动作同时作为世界预测条件和策略学习目标，进行统一因果训练；在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365及真实世界实验中评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OneWM统一因果训练框架，将动作同时作为世界预测条件和策略学习目标，探究世界建模与动作学习之间的互惠关系。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.

analysis.key_results: 实现的几何形状主要是多维的：例如，手腕方向形成一个开放弧线而非圆形，目标距离分别实现在两个正交子空间（接近阶段用粗尺，抓取阶段用细尺）；相同几何形状在基于真实世界机器人数据的两个VLA模型上重现。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了VLA模型中任务相关概念神经几何的初步现象学，表明概念的几何形状与其可读性同样重要。
analysis.method: 使用受控扫描、自然轨迹、线性探针和激活干预来构建七个任务相关概念的几何分类，并在两个额外的VLA模型上验证了发现的几何形状。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文建立了VLA策略中七个任务相关概念的神经几何分类，发现其几何形状是多维的，并受策略执行约束的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA主题高度相关，直接研究VLA策略内部的神经几何结构，并提供了可操作的发现（沿着概念实现几何方向进行引导）。

papers.abstract: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. We introduce WorldCast, a benchmark comprising 320 manually designed cases across eight categories, and evaluate 12 representative models. The conducted experiments yield three key insights: (a) advances in frontier models are rapidly pushing the boundaries of intelligent world modeling, with the GPT-Image-2.5 System scoring 72.8 and demonstrating early-stage visual state prediction capabilities on real-world tasks; (b) WorldCast reveals substantial gaps between models: even Nano Banana Pro reaches only 42.8 and the best open-source model scores 20.1, with deficits in handling complex context, entangled references, and reasoning-heavy tasks; (c) strong generative models effectively draw on the capabilities of their underlying language models. These findings highlight the need for multimodal generative models that are capable of dynamic planning and reasoning while also being deeply unified to faithfully simulate real-world states.

analysis.key_results: GPT-Image-2.5系统得分72.8，Nano Banana Pro得分42.8，最佳开源模型得分20.1。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了WorldCast基准，包含320个手工设计案例，覆盖八个类别，并评估了12个代表性模型。
analysis.method: 通过构建四级能力层级、WorldCast基准以及人工智能评分系统，对模型在多步世界状态预测任务上的表现进行系统性评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了WorldCast基准，用于评估多模态模型在多步世界状态预测任务上的层级能力，并揭示了当前模型在此类高层任务上的性能差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文涉及世界模型和视觉生成能力的评估，但未直接针对机器人动作或世界-动作模型（VLA/WAM）。其基准和层级框架可为世界模型评估提供参考，但与本站的VLA/WAM主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.

analysis.key_results: 构建了涵盖室内外环境及六种探索-回访协议的720个实例，并评估了27个文本、动作和相机条件模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Orbia基准，首个针对交互式世界模型3D一致性进行系统和全面评估的基准。
analysis.method: 通过受控探索与回访，将评估组织为输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度，并使用注册RGB-D参考、注释锚点、跨视图深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性及留出高斯渲染等方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Orbia是首个系统评估交互式世界模型中3D一致性的基准，通过受控探索和回访从输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度进行评测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接针对世界模型（WAM）的3D一致性评估，对机器人世界建模和具身智能中的环境一致性研究具有重要价值，但未涉及VLA或动作预测。

papers.abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $\epsilon$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

analysis.key_results: 在640个案例（384/128/128划分）上，任务得分0.842，grounding F1 0.816，证据召回0.873，接受调用1.74，视觉token 286.5K，p95延迟742ms；密集回放显示0.992动作一致性和0.988证书率，每个决策评估19.6个昂贵交互项而不是191.4个。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出决策可认证的主动证据获取框架，利用反事实证据交互图（CEIG）和间隙导向细化，在保持显式分数包络的同时，以ε决策证书证明所选动作的最优性。
analysis.method: 构建反事实证据交互图（CEIG）表示一元证据值、二阶交互和有向条件危害；使用决策加权包络目标收紧界限；间隙导向细化仅评估可能改变现有获取的交互；在配对延续 rollout 中学习付费预览的下游价值；在线运营成本过滤器与独立有限策略族轨迹认证分离。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种在冻结执行轨迹下、通过可验证的决策证书与证据交互图，在固定元数据与付费观察之间进行主动证据获取决策的方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作涉及视觉-语言多模态智能体中的主动证据获取，与VLA中的视觉信息选择和有界决策验证相关，但未直接涉及机器人操作或世界模型，因此对本站主题属于相邻方法价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

analysis.key_results: 在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准上，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 在单个 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上相比自回归解码平均实现 3.16 倍加速；在每个基准上均优于 DSpark，平均吞吐量提升 7.97%，接受长度提升 8.50%。
analysis.main_contribution: 首个利用混合线性注意力（HLA）循环状态进行位置特定上下文检索的投机解码方法 ReaDy。
analysis.method: 为每个草稿位置使用学习到的查询从目标模型的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文，并通过轻量级状态读取器以残差更新方式集成到草稿表示中，同时采用低秩状态读取和融合算子减少计算与 I/O 开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ReaDy 利用混合线性注意力模型的循环状态为投机解码中的每个草稿位置检索上下文，从而提升草稿质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对投机解码这一独立的高效推理主题，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人学习，因此与本站主题无直接关系，但该方法可潜在应用于任何基于混合线性注意力架构的自回归模型，包括未来可能的具身模型。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared $100$-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains $1.21\times$, $1.46\times$, and $2.30\times$ faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, $43.2\%$ (4B) and $49.0\%$ (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-8B上，HP-RLVR在数学、代码生成和ALFWorld任务中的训练速度分别比GRPO快1.21倍、1.46倍和2.30倍，且每提示的rollout数量仅为GRPO的1/8；总体准确率相当，数学任务上HP-RLVR在所有三种规模上领先，代码和ALFWorld上GRPO领先；ALFWorld中GRPO的梯度范数记录有43.2%（4B）和49.0%（8B）为零，而HP-RLVR为零的比例为零。
analysis.limitations: 在代码生成和ALFWorld任务上GRPO的准确率领先于HP-RLVR。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Hindsight-Privileged RLVR（HP-RLVR），一种单轨迹方法，将已完成轨迹的未来信息转化为令牌级更新权重，无需参考解或学习型评论家。
analysis.method: 使用生成策略快照，分别在因果历史和包含已实现未来及验证器反馈的后见之明上下文中对每个合格令牌打分，计算两个视图之间的归一化Jensen-Shannon散度，并相对于历史基线加权奖励。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HP-RLVR，通过单轨迹后见之明上下文为令牌赋予信用，无需分组采样即可提高强化学习训练速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究的单轨迹令牌信用分配方法对策略学习有方法学价值，但未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模；与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamard matrices as a special case. Interestingly, a class of butterfly matrices belongs to this category. In the realm of LLM quantization, SpectrumQuant bridges the gap between data-agnostic structured rotations and learned rotations, providing an effective and efficient data-aware alternative for post-training quantization. Experiments on Llama and Mistral models show that SpectrumQuant is competitive with state-of-the-art rotation strategies while requiring less than one-third of the GPU memory and significantly less time than learned rotations approaches like SpinQuant and DartQuant.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama和Mistral模型上，SpectrumQuant与最先进的旋转策略具有竞争力，GPU内存占用不到SpinQuant和DartQuant等学习旋转方法的三分之一，时间显著更少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpectrumQuant，一种基于激活协方差的闭式旋转方法，用于构建量化友好的正交变换，弥合数据无关结构化旋转与学习旋转之间的差距。
analysis.method: 从校准数据估计激活协方差，利用谱对齐原理构造协方差感知正交变换，其形式化为对齐和混合分量的组合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SpectrumQuant提出了一种协方差感知的正交变换方法，通过最大化协方差实现谱对齐，用于LLM的训练后量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法虽针对LLM量化提出，但作为通用的训练后量化技术，可潜在地应用于VLA或世界模型中的Transformer组件，以降低推理成本；摘要未涉及机器人或世界模型。

papers.abstract: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $\pi_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $\pi_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.

analysis.key_results: 四个真实世界任务套件中，FoveaVLA-Single成功率70.8%，FoveaVLA-Dual成功率77.1%，腕部相机基线为52.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FoveaVLA，用学习到的注视动作替代腕部相机，在VLA中实现高效的细节感知。
analysis.method: 在π0.5基础上，预测下一步观察的交互区域，并将原分辨率裁剪的注视区域与全视图一起输入策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FoveaVLA通过预测注视区域并融合局部与原图特征，在VLA中替代腕部相机，提升操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于VLA研究，通过主动注视替代腕部相机，提升机器人操作中的视觉感知效率。

figures.caption: FoveaVLA replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions: it predicts the next interaction region and observes it at high resolution. The π0.5 wrist-equipped matches it when the target is already in the wrist view, but degrades with distractors and far-away objects, where FoveaVLA’s foveal crop keeps the relevant detail in sight.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: FoveaVLA overview (Single shown). Full and foveal RGB images and aligned depth maps are encoded together with the task instruction and robot state. From this shared representation, the action expert generates an action chunk, while the language-model head autoregressively generates interaction boxes that select the foveal crops for the next observation. Dual adds the same four image inputs from a second external view and predicts one box per view.

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. In comparison with state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods, JetSpec++ attains a wall-clock speedup of up to $7.45\times$ over autoregressive (AR) decoding and $1.54\times$ over DSpark, with up to 1,361 tokens per second for a single request on GB200, and an average acceptance length of 8.94 across seven benchmarks, while preserving the target model's output distribution. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec.

analysis.key_results: 相比最先进的推测解码方法，墙钟加速最高达7.45倍于自回归解码，1.54倍于DSpark；GB200上单请求最高1,361 tokens/s；七个基准上的平均接受长度8.94；保持目标模型输出分布。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出JetSpec++，通过块内自精炼、块间预见草稿生成和流水线草稿与验证三个组件，协同优化草稿token的接受率与生成成本。
analysis.method: 块内自精炼训练草稿模型迭代纠正自身并行预测；块间预见草稿在当前块验证前开始生成下一块；流水线草稿与验证重叠两阶段。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: JetSpec++通过算法-系统协同设计，在保留强学习草稿模型的同时几乎完全隐藏其成本，实现最高7.45倍于自回归解码的墙钟加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于独立推测解码技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型；但其提出的通用高效推理方法可潜在地应用于机器人策略模型或世界模型的加速部署。

papers.title_zh: JetSpec++：具有自精炼的预见性并行草稿生成

papers.abstract: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务中，相比固定水平基线，PICES在Jetson Orin和Thor上实现最高2.3倍的策略推理时间加速，同时提高了成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练无关的PICES方法，在单次策略调用中利用多个噪声样本及其扰动对应项之间的差异，联合选择动作块和执行水平，从而加速VLA推理。
analysis.method: PICES，基于扰动信息的块与执行水平选择：动作专家从多个初始噪声样本及其局部扰动对应项生成批量动作块，利用名义块与对应项之间的动作差异确定候选特定执行水平并选择名义块执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PICES方法，通过联合选择动作块和执行水平，在保证成功率的同时加速VLA模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型的推理加速，通过动态调整执行水平减少策略调用次数，属于VLA高效推理的核心研究。

figures.caption: High-level idea of the PICES. (a) Fixed execution horizon generates a nominal action chunk from a single initial noise sample at each policy call and executes a fixed-length actions before replanning. (b) PICES uses multiple initial-noise samples and their perturbations to determine execution horizon of nominal action chunk. Our method reduces the number of policy calls required to complete the same episode, from four to two in the illustrated example. (c) Success rate versus speedup comparison across methods, showing that PICES achieves wall-clock inference time speedup while preserving success rate.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present VLX-GO, a vision-language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/om-ai-lab/VLX-Go.

analysis.key_results: 在干扰跟踪成功率上，完整多阶段训练达到55.80%（基线OmTrackVLA为41.54%），在线精化后进一步提高到58.22%，碰撞率降低1.99个百分点，在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰和模糊跟踪成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLX-Go，一个多阶段训练的视觉-语言航点策略，用于在干扰人群中鲁棒地跟踪指定人员，并通过在线策略精化进一步提升性能。
analysis.method: 结合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文、Transformer主干和轻量级航点预测头；训练依次进行视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理微调和跟踪任务专业化，并使用过滤的预言机标签进行在线策略精化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种视觉-语言航点策略VLX-Go，通过多阶段学习（视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理、跟踪专业化）和在线策略精化，提升有人环境中人员跟随的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在具身跟踪任务中的应用，与VLA主题核心相关；未涉及世界模型（WAM）。

figures.caption: VLX-Go architecture and training workflow. (A) Frozen DINOv3 and SigLIP features are concatenated and pooled into 188 visual tokens: 31 × ( 2 × 2 ) 31\times(2\times 2) for history and 8 × 8 8\times 8 for the current frame. A vision–language adapter projects these features into a transformer backbone; temporal/view indicators, instruction tokens, and a learnable action query complete the input. A three-layer MLP decodes the action state into eight robot-centric waypoints. (B) Three offline stages train the adapter, then the backbone and adapter, and finally the backbone, adapter, and waypoint head. (C) DAgger collects policy rollouts, labels visited states with the oracle, filters the labels, and fine-tunes on aggregated rollouts and demonstrations. The updated policy supplies the next round of rollouts. Visual encoders remain frozen throughout. Scene and robot images are illustrative.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

analysis.key_results: 在模型基动作判别中，SonoWorld在高达74.8%的试验中正确将目标导向探针运动排在等幅反向运动之上；通过用户研究验证了可控性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SonoWorld，一个因果超声世界模型，从无标签临床视频学习视频动态，并通过小型EM跟踪数据集将其接地到6-DoF控制，为机器人超声提供数据驱动的交互式环境。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练：在大规模无标签多器官超声帧上预训练潜动作条件视频扩散模型；使用小型EM跟踪甲状腺数据集将视频动态接地到度量探针位姿；应用分布匹配蒸馏实现因果、长时程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性缓存驱逐token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个因果、位姿可控的超声世界模型SonoWorld，用于机器人超声数据采集与策略评估。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是构建可位姿控制的超声世界模型，属于机器人世界模型研究，可直接为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供仿真环境，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Starting from the same initial ultrasound frame, SonoWorld generates distinct sequences of future ultrasound views along different 6-DoF probe scan paths, which captures how probe motion determines the evolving image appearance and ultimately the reconstructed 3D thyroid anatomy.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Three stages of ultrasound world model development. (a) Pretraining. A bidirectional DiT is trained on large-scale unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound videos, conditioned on the diffusion timestep t t and latent actions 𝐳 \mathbf{z} via adaptive layer normalization. (b) Post-training. The model is then post-trained on high-quality thyroid ultrasound videos paired with EM tracker poses, replacing the latent action with the physical action. (c) Causal transform. The bidirectional model is finally distilled into a causal DiT via distribution matching distillation (DMD) Yin et al. (2024) .
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title_zh: SonoWorld：迈向交互式位姿可控的超声世界模型

papers.abstract: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce LoopWAM, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67% to 43.33%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 49.5% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20% to 55.56%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. Project page: https://loop-wam.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboChallenge Table30-V2上，三轮部署训练使成功率从23.67%提升至43.33%（提升19.7个百分点），最终得分56.80；在RoboTwin 2.0上平均成功率达94.5%；在RoboCasa365上整体成功率49.5%，在三个基准上均取得对比方法中最佳结果；在具有挑战性的叠衣任务上，单任务后训练后两轮部署改进将成功率从13.20%提升至55.56%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LoopWAM，一个闭环世界-动作模型，能够直接利用包含成功、次优和失败的全质量谱部署数据进行策略学习，无需过滤或仅模仿成功轨迹。
analysis.method: 源相关噪声采样统一行为学习和动作条件世界建模；质量引导和质量加权监督保持全视频监督并调节动作模仿；视频和动作令牌在并行去噪过程中交互，使学习到的后果直接指导动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LoopWAM提出一种闭环世界-动作模型，从混合质量的部署轨迹中学习，通过质量加权和源相关噪声采样实现持续策略改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以世界-动作模型（WAM）为核心，直接面向机器人策略学习与部署数据闭环改进，与本站主题高度相关。其在多任务机器人学习、动作条件视频生成和策略部署改进方面的贡献，可为本领域提供新的方法框架和实验基准。

figures.caption: LoopWAM learns from deployment. Mixed-quality rollouts return to training through quality steering, source-dependent noise sampling, and quality-weighted supervision. Center: closed-loop self-improvement on RoboChallenge Table30-V2, where three rounds of deployment and retraining increase overall success from 23.67% to 43.33%. Bottom: benchmark comparisons.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of LoopWAM. LoopWAM is structured as a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture, where bidirectional attention enables feature interaction between the video and action branches. Training combines quality-conditioned instructions, source-dependent noise sampling, and quality-weighted action supervision. Expert trajectories supervise both modalities, while lower-quality rollouts retain full world supervision and contribute to action imitation according to their quality. The trained model is deployed using the expert score q ⋆ q^{\star} , and recorded experience returns to the next training round.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
papers.title_zh: LoopWAM：基于部署轨迹的闭环通才机器人策略改进

papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard: https://worldoracle-benchmark.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在七个代表性行动条件世界模型上的实验揭示了各模型的不同优势和失败模式。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了WorldOracle基准，用于系统评估行动条件世界模型（ACWMs）在真实操作场景下的预测性能，涵盖四个评估维度并提供数据集、评估代码和排行榜。
analysis.method: 通过给定相同初始观察和低级行动序列，比较模型预测的rollout与真实世界执行的结果，从物理状态正确性、交互空间对齐、关键交互区域保真度和多视角行动一致性四个维度进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldOracle是一个基准，旨在通过与真实世界执行对比来评估行动条件世界模型在操作任务中的预测准确性和多维度性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接关注行动条件世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的评估，与本站WAM和机器人学习主题高度相关，为WAM的发展提供了基准和系统评估工具。

figures.caption: Overview of WorldOracle. (a) The human-operated trajectories are collected through robot teleoperation or direct human-hand execution. (b) The policy-rollout trajectories are collected by running a policy in closed loop on a real robot. (c) For both distributions, the recorded action trajectory is replayed open loop by the ACWM, yielding a generated rollout. (d) The predicted rollout is compared with the paired real execution along four dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence.

papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard: https://worldoracle-benchmark.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 对七个代表性ACWMs的实验揭示了各自的优势与失效模式。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了WorldOracle基准，通过将预测的 rollout 与真实执行配对，系统评估ACWMs在物理状态正确性、交互空间对齐、关键交互区域保真度和多视角动作一致性四个维度的表现。
analysis.method: 构建真实世界训练与评估套件，包含不同交互动力学和具身形态的长序列、多段、成功与失败执行数据，并使用四维指标评估动作条件世界模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldOracle是一个用于评估动作条件世界模型（ACWMs）是否准确再现真实机器人操作执行结果的基准。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于动作条件世界模型（WAM）的评估与基准建设，属于机器人操作中世界建模的核心方向，对本站WAM主题具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上跨视觉和文本任务，相比原始自推测方法一致提升高达11%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SP²ec（Single-Peak SPeculative decoding），一种免训练的bandit算法，在自推测解码中自适应调整草稿配置，并理论保证墙钟时间遗憾（wall-time regret）最小化。
analysis.method: 利用自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，采用bandit算法动态选择草稿配置，显式最小化每个查询的墙钟时间遗憾。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SP²ec，一种免训练的自适应bandit算法，在自推测解码中动态调整草稿配置以加速视觉语言模型推理。

papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三个真实世界操作任务上平均真实世界成功率达88.3%（最强基线为76.7%）；在WorldArena中三项动作条件世界建模任务均领先；AC-WM联合训练改善所有动作接口的生成，PAIR将OOD成功率从63.3%提升到76.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniW(A)M框架，利用混合专家扩散Transformer统一动作条件世界建模和多种WAM变体，并设计PAIR插件式自适应接口路由器，在冻结骨干网络的情况下根据目标任务块场景选择合适接口。
analysis.method: 基于扩散Transformer的混合专家模型，共享专家捕捉通用动态，原子能力专家跨接口复用；部署时通过PAIR从少量目标任务块场景中学习接口选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一的世界与世界-动作模型混合专家框架UniW(A)M，共享物理动态并通过自适应接口路由平衡任务成功率和执行效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦世界-动作模型（WAM），统一世界建模与动作生成，并通过联合训练和自适应路由提升机器人操作中的OOD泛化能力和执行效率，对本站主题高度相关。
