papers.abstract: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.

analysis.key_results: 在BAGEL、Qwen-Image和Wan-Image-7B上，RSIgen在AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9上比SearchGen三周期自适应提升3.2-3.3分；在200个真实用户请求盲评中，任务完成偏好得分达70.0%，视觉质量64.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出任务中心的互惠自改进框架RSIgen，动态协调视觉生成中代理与生成器角色的学习，刷新代理监督并构建递归课程，提升任务完成质量。
analysis.method: 采用动态责任路由（DRR），基于证据、输入和受支持动作的匹配干预选择学习角色并构造训练目标；在生成器学习后，固定分支输入重新评估动作效用以刷新代理监督，并构建下一轮课程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RSIgen框架，通过动态责任路由和递归课程构建，实现代理式视觉生成中代理与生成器角色的互惠自改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦代理式视觉生成，通过生成经验提升多模态骨干的代理与生成能力，与视觉语言模型和世界建模相关。它不直接针对机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或动作世界模型（WAM），但其代理与生成器的互惠学习机制可能为构建面向动作的生成式世界模型提供方法论参考。

papers.abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

analysis.key_results: 在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad和WorldArena上排名第一；受控研究表明动作条件、几何交互和共享表示中的多功能训练具有益处。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Thinker-WM，一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的中间Unified Dynamics Transformer联合建模和生成RGB、度量深度和机器人动作，支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成和逆动力学等多种功能。
analysis.method: 采用模态特定编码器和解码器，将外观、几何和动作转换到统一的动态表示，由共享参数共同演化；训练数据包括约20K小时自我中心视频、10K小时真实机器人数据和1K小时仿真数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Thinker-WM是一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享中间动力学Transformer联合建模和生成RGB、度量深度和机器人动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文属于世界建模（WAM）核心主题，统一表示包含动作，与机器人动作预测和具身智能直接相关。

papers.abstract: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

analysis.key_results: 八种开源和专有MLLM在MMTA上均存在将时间序列表示为文本导致的长序列和细粒度对齐弱化问题，尤其在长视频设置中；TimeOmni-v改善了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了覆盖九个领域的三模态时序分析基准MMTA，标准化异构数据并设计成功加权指标；评估八种MLLM揭示时间序列文本化导致的表示与对齐瓶颈；提出TimeOmni-v模型扩展以提升长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.method: MMTA基准采用视频+时间序列和图像+时间序列两种布局，统一为共享模式并包含领域特定提示、来源文档和成功加权指标；TimeOmni-v模型引入专用时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知标记布局和预测头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个包含时间序列、文本和视觉的三模态基准MMTA，用于评估多模态大模型在分类和预测任务上的表现，并发现时间序列文本化导致的表示瓶颈，进而提出TimeOmni-v模型改进长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作为多模态时序分析建立基准并改进表示效率，涉及机器人等应用领域，但未直接针对VLA或世界模型；其时间序列编码与对齐方法可能对具身模型的时间序列处理有参考价值，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

analysis.key_results: GPT-5.6-Sol成功率为17%，人类参与者为100%；模型在改善剪影重叠的同时恶化姿态对齐的比例为19.4%，高于人类的10.9%；移除交互历史后，96.8%的模型动作处于粗糙的30度步长，成功率显著下降。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoTA-Bench基准，用于评估模型从2D观察推断3D几何和通过交互实现精确3D控制的能力。
analysis.method: 基于剪影保持的自动流水线从2D图标构建3D物体，并采用可逆初始化保证可解性，生成674个任务和100个分层测试任务。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该基准测试通过交互式3D到2D投影对齐任务评估视觉语言模型的3D空间推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作不直接涉及VLA或世界模型，但评估视觉语言模型的3D空间推理和交互控制能力，对机器人操作中的感知与规划具有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: We use a frozen frontier vision-language model, GPT-6-Astra, directly as the robot policy on RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 memory-dependent manipulation tasks spanning temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory. The model keeps the whole episode in context and outputs every end-effector waypoint and gripper command, with no RoboMME-specific training. On the 800 test episodes it succeeds in 92.1%, above the previously reported human score of 90.5%, which was obtained with an oracle skill interface, and far ahead of the best leaderboard entry (60.8%) and of a hierarchical system that pairs the same model with a RoboMME-trained policy (79.1%). It matches or exceeds the human score on 13 of the 16 tasks. Its 63 failures concentrate in two tasks and are mostly premature completions and mistimed or unintended button presses. These results blur the usual division between long-horizon planning, memory and end-effector control, and raise the question of how much of this stack a single general-purpose model can take over in embodied systems. Project website: https://embodied-astra.github.io. Code, prompts and all episode logs: https://github.com/jackbjed/embodied-astra-robomme.

analysis.key_results: 在800个测试回合中成功率为92.1%，超过先知技能界面的人类得分90.5%，远高于最佳排行榜条目60.8%和同模型与RoboMME训练策略的分层系统79.1%；在16项任务中的13项达到或超过人类得分。
analysis.limitations: 63次失败集中在两项任务上，主要是过早完成和误时或非预期的按钮按下。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明一个冻结的前沿视觉语言模型，无需针对RoboMME的训练，即可直接作为端到端机器人策略，在记忆依赖型操作任务上超越人类基准和已有最佳系统。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的GPT-6-Astra模型作为机器人策略，将整个回合上下文输入模型，直接输出末端执行器路径点和夹爪指令，无RoboMME特定训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 将冻结的前沿VLM GPT-6-Astra直接作为机器人策略，在16项记忆依赖型操作基准RoboMME上取得92.1%成功率，超越人类基准成绩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心研究：将通用VLM直接作为VLA策略，测试其在长期规划、记忆和末端控制一体化任务中的能力，为VLA发展提供重要实验证据。

papers.abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models can be run using frameworks such as vLLM and MLX, with quantized versions available to reduce memory usage.Inference code and links to model weights are available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Startlux-Decision .

analysis.key_results: 在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant模型比最强可比规模开放权重决策模型高出7.4-16.9分；27B AutoThink达到73.4分。RLCD²将推理跟踪在生成限制内终止的比例提高最多48个百分点，平均推理长度减少最多65%。在DecisionPivot上，AutoThink比Instant对应模型准确率高出11.5-18.4分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了StartLux-Decision决策模型，包括Instant（单遍）和AutoThink（自适应推理）变体，以及RLCD²强化学习方法，用于校准决策置信度并控制推理令牌长度，同时保持准确性。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练管线：共享能力训练、变体专业化、AutoThink推理监督与强化学习；RLCD²使用冻结模型和proper scoring rules优化决策概率质量并惩罚过长推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了从0.8B到27B参数的决策模型系列，结合单遍高效预测与自适应推理，并引入RLCD²方法以校准推理长度并提高效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要关注决策模型中的高效推理与量化，未直接涉及机器人操作、视觉语言动作（VLA）或世界模型（WAM）。其量化版本和高效推理方法可能对资源受限的机器人部署具有潜在借鉴意义，但摘要未明确建立与机器人或体现智能的联系。

papers.abstract: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

analysis.key_results: 五种通用机器人策略（含VLA和世界-动作模型）的性能随着工业约束引入和组合而逐渐下降；在共享微调和评估协议下，LIBERO-Industry联合训练条件的完成率高于原始LIBERO条件。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了LIBERO-Industry基准，将工业过程约束转化为可控任务条件和可测量的成功标准，包含216个任务。
analysis.method: 在LIBERO基础上构建三个任务场景（S2D、D2S、D2D），系统变化物体几何、传送带速度、交互窗口和几何接受区域大小。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LIBERO-Industry是一个基于LIBERO的新基准，用于在工业过程约束下系统评估通用机器人策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准明确评估了视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）在工业操作任务中的表现，直接服务于VLA/WAM的评估与改进。

papers.abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.

analysis.key_results: 在Gated DeltaNet、GLA、Mamba2和RetNet上，该方法显著优于INT4，状态内存减少达5.3倍，解码速度提升达1.9倍（相对于FP32状态）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Low-Rank Bypass (LRB)和Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR)两种训练无关干预手段，有效缓解低比特量化循环状态时的误差积累问题。
analysis.method: 在量化舍入前后分别进行干预：舍入前用低秩缓冲累积小更新并定期合并；舍入时限制舍入方向，使被舍入元素向更新方向靠拢。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练无关的低比特循环状态量化方法，通过低保真误差积累实现高效推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于循环网络状态的低比特量化，属于独立的模型量化研究，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。其量化方法对高效推理有潜在价值，但摘要未建立与机器人领域的直接联系。

papers.abstract: Quantization lowers deployment costs of vision-language-action (VLA) policies but can compromise task completion. Across five VLA models and 4,050 real-world trials, we systematically reveal that quantization-aware training (QAT) generally improves on post-training quantization (PTQ) but leaves substantial gaps to full precision (FP) on long-horizon tasks and under visual and semantic shifts, while its imitation-based objective does not explicitly use rollout success or partial completion. To exploit these outcome signals, we introduce Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (QCRL), an offline RL method coupling progress-based advantage estimation with quantization-aware source conditioning. FP rollouts supply reference experience beyond action-level distillation, progress-scaled terminal penalty distinguishes partial completion, and quantization-aware conditioning selects advantageous reference behavior within the quantized policy. We evaluate weight-only INT4 W4A16 on $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 and joint weight-activation NVFP4 W4A4 on $\pi_{0.5}$. Using only in-distribution data, QCRL reaches 99.3% of FP's mean score across three visual-shift conditions for $\pi_{0.5}$ with INT4 W4A16, alongside 42.9% model-memory savings. With NVFP4 W4A4, it reaches 100.7% of the same FP baseline, alongside a $1.73\times$ speedup using NVFP4/FP8 deployment. Hardware gains are relative to FP16 on Jetson Thor.

analysis.key_results: 在π0.5上，INT4 W4A16达到FP均值的99.3%，节省42.9%模型内存；NVFP4 W4A4达到100.7%，在Jetson Thor上实现1.73倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QCRL（量化条件强化学习），利用成功和部分完成等结果信号，结合进度优势估计与量化感知源条件，显著恢复量化VLA策略的性能。
analysis.method: RLOO风格的离线强化学习，使用FP rollout提供参考体验，进度缩放终端惩罚区分部分完成，量化感知条件选择有利参考行为。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对量化导致的VLA策略性能下降，提出量化条件强化学习方法，利用进展优势估计和量化感知源条件参考行为，恢复低比特模型的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA策略的量化部署，通过强化学习恢复量化导致的动作预测精度损失，对VLA的高效推理和机器人操作性能至关重要。

papers.abstract: Converting natural-language instructions into executable action plans conditioned on a scene image is a core capability for embodied human-robot interaction, but existing benchmarks target English, simulated or video-grounded environments, and largely assume instructions are clear and executable. We introduce the first Persian vision-language-action dataset for this task: 258 instances over 230 real household/office photographs, annotated with reference plans, deliberate ambiguity and infeasibility labels, disambiguating question-answer pairs, and an auto-generated chain-of-thought rationale for training. Using this resource, we ablate retrieval-augmentation, chain-of-thought prompting, and an agentic disambiguation step, evaluated with an LLM-as-judge protocol and a new metric, PGOS-FA, extending prior work (PG2S) with step-order sensitivity, an over-generation penalty, and Persian-adapted embeddings. Paired statistical testing across 36 comparisons shows retrieval-augmentation is a large, robustly significant effect, while finer-grained additions are directionally consistent but not statistically distinguishable from noise at this scale, and the LLM-judge metric has near-zero power where PGOS-FA succeeds. A blind human-correlation study on 79 real outputs shows PGOS-FA tracks human judgment at least as closely as the LLM-judge. Testing generalization beyond the ablation's single backbone, we find that most of the gap between an open-weight and a substantially stronger closed planner is attributable to open-weight model generation rather than to the closed model's capability specifically, and that our best configuration significantly outperforms an independently reproduced external baseline despite a weaker backbone. The dataset, PGOS-FA implementation, and evaluation code will be made available upon reasonable request.

analysis.key_results: 检索增强在36项成对统计检验中表现出大且稳健的显著效果；细粒度添加方向一致但统计上不显著；LLM-judge在PGOS-FA可区分的情况下检验力近零；PGOS-FA与人工判断的相关性不弱于LLM-judge；开放权重模型与闭源规划器差距主要源于生成而非闭源能力特性；最佳配置显著优于外部复现基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 发布第一个波斯语视觉-语言-动作数据集（258个实例、230张真实家庭/办公室照片），并引入PGOS-FA评估指标及基准测试，涵盖歧义、不可行性标签与消歧问答对。
analysis.method: 构建带参考计划、歧义/不可行性标签、消歧问答对和自动生成思维链理由的数据集；消融检索增强、思维链提示与代理式消歧步骤；采用LLM-as-judge和PGOS-FA指标评估，并进行人工相关性研究及泛化测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了第一个波斯语视觉-语言-动作数据集与基准，用于评估从自然语言指令到可执行行动计划的落地能力，重点关注歧义与不可行性。

papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

analysis.key_results: 在笔记本GPU上执行了调度，包含三种权重格式的长上下文调度和工具使用基准测试；实验显示上下文感知精度分配的优势以及准确率恢复的局限性。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出准确率恢复在某些情况下仍然有限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出上下文感知的精度调度框架，结合校准的时序模型与权重敏感性，在延迟或准确率约束下分配混合精度，并实现运行时按调度执行且保留KV缓存。
analysis.method: 从不同精度和上下文长度的测量中校准时序模型，结合张量敏感性选择配置；延迟预算下根据KV缓存读取时间调整权重精度，准确率预算下根据量化KV缓存误差动态调整权重精度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种上下文感知的混合精度调度方法，通过校准时序模型和权重敏感性，在延迟或准确率预算下为小语言模型动态选择张量精度。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\times$, $5.98\times$, and $24.84\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/changdong1687/1Step-WAM.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin和LIBERO上，1Step-WAM仅用约13.4M可训练参数即可保持多步任务成功率，并将FastWAM、ImageWAM和Kairos的推理速度分别提升7.44倍、5.98倍和24.84倍；真实机器人部署确认FastWAM主干获得7.44倍加速且成功率接近多步基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出1Step-WAM框架，利用轻量校准器修正第一步速度并采用带宽受限动作解码，将多步动作去噪转化为单次前向，从而打破视觉预填充与动作预测之间的顺序瓶颈。
analysis.method: 基于WAM动作去噪轨迹近似直线的观察，使用轻量校准器直接校正第一步速度，结合带宽受限动作解码，实现单步动作生成并与视觉预填充并行执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过将多步动作去噪压缩为单步前向，并与视觉预填充并行执行，1Step-WAM显著加速世界动作模型推理，同时保持任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对世界动作模型（WAM）进行推理加速，属于本站核心主题VLA/WAM的高效推理优化，具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明FireNav在导航成功率和路径效率上一致超越最先进基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了FireNav，一个决策导向的重建证据路由框架，以及FireVLN-Bench，一个带有清晰参考、安全监督和匹配设置的成对室内火灾导航基准。
analysis.method: 保留原生视觉token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据，轻量路由器根据视觉特征、任务上下文和先前执行状态决定是否采纳及贡献权重；并通过决策效用校准比较有无候选证据时的动作预测损失来监督证据选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FireNav框架通过决策导向的重建证据路由将视觉恢复与导航效用对齐，并在新提出的FireVLN-Bench基准上提升了火灾场景视觉语言导航的成功率和路径效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究针对视觉语言导航（VLN）这一视觉-语言-动作任务，涉及机器人执行与模拟动态，属于VLA范畴。通过决策导向的证据路由，将视觉恢复与导航决策对齐，对VLA在退化环境中的鲁棒性提升有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Open-world mobile manipulation requires a robot to find an object, approach it, and move it to a target receptacle from a language instruction. Training vision-language model (VLM) agents for these tasks requires demonstrations of both action selection and active vision. Existing pipelines often convert planned trajectories into high-level action labels, but shortest-path progress provides limited supervision for deciding where to look. We introduce Agent-Interface Data Alignment (AIDA), a data collection pipeline in which a teacher directly selects and executes actions through the deployed agent's skill interface. For mobile manipulation, we design teachers that maintain target visibility, recover lost targets, and approach for picking or placing. We add template-based spatial reasoning supervision and use a shared harness to organize observations, history, and outputs during training and inference. The resulting agent, AIDA-OWMM, achieves 71.76% full-task success on 170 held-out OWMM episodes. Teacher sensitivity analysis shows that active-vision demonstrations improve student success. The simulation-trained agent achieves 38% end-to-end success on a real mobile robot without additional training. Applying AIDA to a navigation subset of EmbodiedBench further demonstrates the pipeline's utility for navigation tasks.

analysis.key_results: 基于AIDA训练的智能体AIDA-OWMM在170个留出OWMM回合上实现71.76%的全任务成功率；仿真训练的智能体在真实移动机器人上端到端成功率为38%，无需额外训练；在EmbodiedBench导航子集上的应用进一步证明了管道的效用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Agent-Interface Data Alignment（AIDA）数据收集管道，在移动操作任务中直接对齐教师示范与智能体技能接口，提升VLM智能体的学习效果。
analysis.method: 教师通过部署智能体的技能接口直接选择并执行动作，结合模板化空间推理监督，并在训练与推理中采用统一的观察、历史和输出组织形式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出AIDA数据收集管道，使教师通过部署智能体的技能接口直接选择和执行动作，用于训练开放世界移动操作的VLM智能体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究直接面向视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在真实移动操作任务中的训练与部署，提出了新型数据对齐方法以提升动作选择与主动视觉能力，对VLA/WAM研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly generate robot actions token by token through Large Language Model (LLM) decoders, causing inference latency to grow with action sequence length and limiting closed-loop control frequency. We present Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA), which replaces autoregressive decoders with a lightweight latent control loop. A shared vision encoder and a frozen text encoder embed observations, goal images, and instructions; a neuro-symbolic selector chooses a discrete skill; a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor forecasts the next latent state; and a flow-matching solver generates an entire action chunk in a few integration steps, so that sequential network evaluations per decision step do not depend on the action horizon. We analyze inference complexity, regularization against representation collapse, and conditions under which latent sub-goal thresholding limits error accumulation across task phases. As an initial proof of concept, we evaluated VPA on the LIBERO-10 suite. The trainable model has under 20M parameters (checkpoint under 75 MB, excluding a frozen 63.4M-parameter CLIP text encoder); a decision step of a single-camera reference configuration takes 10-14 ms on an Apple M4; and trained only on LIBERO-10 demonstrations in under three hours on a single GPU, a two-camera policy succeeded in 40.0% of 200 evaluation episodes. These preliminary results from a single training run suggest the approach is workable. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/ylee-sling/Vision-Predictor-Action and https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/vpa-libero10, and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22960920.

analysis.key_results: 训练模型参数低于20M（检查点小于75 MB，不含冻结的63.4M参数CLIP文本编码器）；单相机参考配置的决策步骤在Apple M4上耗时10-14ms；仅在LIBERO-10演示数据上训练不到3小时，双相机策略在200个评估回合中成功率为40.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VPA模型，通过神经符号技能选择、JEPA潜状态预测和流匹配动作生成，替代VLA模型中的自回归LLM解码器，显著降低推理时间并摆脱对动作时长的依赖。
analysis.method: 共享视觉编码器与冻结文本编码器嵌入观测、目标图像和指令；神经符号选择器选择离散技能；JEPA预测器预测下一潜状态；流匹配求解器在少量积分步骤内生成整个动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA)模型，用轻量潜控制循环替代VLA中的自回归解码器，实现与动作序列长度无关的高效推理。

papers.abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

analysis.key_results: 在OGBench Cube上CEM规划成功率从52%提升到68%，OGBench Scene从49%提升到77%，CALVIN从29%提升到51%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入SpecWM框架，通过目标相似性核显式指定表示几何，并通过时间核的谱对齐改善机器人控制规划成功率。
analysis.method: SpecWM采用JEPA框架，训练编码器在嵌入几何中重现目标相似性核指定的观察关系，包括物理状态核和全自监督时间核。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SpecWM，一种通过谱表示学习显式指定观察之间目标相似性核的JEPA框架，并展示其在机器人控制规划中的性能提升。

papers.abstract: Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.

analysis.key_results: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，RGT显著提升了跨图领域的结构知识迁移能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出黎曼图分词器（RGT），将图结构编码为离散token，通过几何词汇、黎曼量化器和几何对齐解码器实现跨领域结构知识迁移。
analysis.method: 定义几何词汇（树、环、序列）捕捉基本结构模式；构建带黎曼直通估计器的量化器将图结构离散化为token；加入几何对齐解码器将特定流形的token投影到统一切空间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于黎曼几何的图分词器，将图结构量化为离散token以支持跨领域结构知识迁移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于图结构数据的量化分词与知识迁移，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界建模。但其模型量化思想可能为VLA/WAM中的离散表示学习或模型压缩提供方法借鉴。

papers.abstract: In embodied manipulation, Vision Language Action (VLA) models can execute atomic skills, but long-horizon manipulation requires recombining these skills without demonstrations for every skill combination. The full instruction route treats skill chaining as long-horizon imitation. In a controlled study, full instruction training on limited skill combination sequences reaches 40.0% ordered success on covered combinations but only 7.7% on recombination, suggesting memorization of sequence templates rather than robust skill recombination. We introduce Hierarchical Subtask Execution (HSE), a diagnostic framework that exposes skill recombination through a shared modular interface over the planner, trigger, and policy, decomposing long-horizon failures into separable modes. We introduce RoboCombine, a benchmark for skill recombination without combined skill training trajectories, with metrics for ordered success and transition conversion across subtask boundaries. RoboCombine reveals that atomic competence alone does not ensure ordered execution. Failures concentrate at transitions where downstream subtasks launch from handoff states from preceding subtasks rather than canonical atomic starts. We identify this mismatch as the start state gap. To address it, we introduce Pose Robust Task Initialization (PRTI), a lightweight atomic task post-training strategy that broadens start state coverage beyond canonical starts. Under oracle timed HSE on RoboCombine, PRTI reaches 18.16% ordered success, compared with 4.21% under random perturbation and 9.47% under a robot-reset oracle, without combined skill training trajectories. These results show that combinatorial generalization requires handoff robust atomic skills that convert first stage progress into reliable downstream execution, not merely decomposition into known subtasks. Code: https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboCombine.

analysis.key_results: 全指令训练在覆盖组合上达到40.0%有序成功率，但在重组上仅7.7%；在RoboCombine上，PRTI在oracle timed HSE下达到18.16%有序成功率，优于随机扰动的4.21%和robot-reset oracle的9.47%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Hierarchical Subtask Execution (HSE)诊断框架、RoboCombine基准及Pose Robust Task Initialization (PRTI)训练策略，用于分解长程操作失败模式并提升原子技能的起始状态鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 通过HSE框架将长程任务分解为规划器、触发器和策略的模块化接口，并在RoboCombine基准上使用PRTI对原子任务进行后训练以扩大起始状态覆盖。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究VLA模型在长程操作中技能重组问题，提出诊断框架、基准和训练策略以提升组合泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA模型在具身操作中的技能组合泛化问题，提出的诊断框架、基准和训练策略对提升VLA模型的鲁棒性和组合泛化能力具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

analysis.key_results: 在CNN/DailyMail摘要和GSM8K子集上使用Qwen3-30B-A3B，SpecFit比使用相同专家缓存的EAGLE-3解码快21.6%和7.0%，且分别是vanilla EAGLE-3的1.97倍和1.72倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpecFit方法，在专家权重卸载的MoE模型中，通过选择最大化预测吞吐量的草稿子树，而不是最大化接受长度，来优化推测解码效率。
analysis.method: SpecFit根据草稿路径概率估计提交令牌数量，并根据节点数及子树激活专家的每层并集（单调次模覆盖函数）预测周期时间；对祖先闭合子树进行精确搜索以选择最高预测吞吐量的子树，并在每个草稿级别后运行相同搜索以决定停止草稿。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SpecFit方法，通过预测吞吐量而非接受长度来选择验证草稿子树，以降低MoE专家卸载场景下推测解码的H2D传输开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于MoE模型专家卸载下的推测解码优化，属于通用高效推理方法，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其吞吐量感知的推测解码思路可能对资源受限机器人端的VLA推理效率提升具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

analysis.key_results: 获得约6倍KV压缩，比标量k3v2小约20%，在80%的模型-数据集-上下文设置中优于标量k3v2，且保持解码吞吐量不变。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次展示均匀2位键与2位值配置（k2v2）可通过E8格向量量化保持近基线质量，同时获得约6倍KV缓存压缩。
analysis.method: 基于E8格的向量量化，利用相邻维度的相关性，并采用免去码本反量化的表格非对称评分算法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出基于E8格向量量化的KV缓存压缩方法，实现2比特键值对近基线性能的存储节省。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文工作属于独立的量化技术，未涉及VLA/WAM或机器人，但对VLA/WAM模型的高效推理可能具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Zero-Shot Object Navigation (ZSON) requires an agent to locate target objects in unfamiliar environments without additional training for the test categories or environments. Recent approaches leverage large language models and vision-language models to construct spatial representations and guide exploration. However, whether the available evidence sufficiently supports a navigation choice, and how new evidence changes the search value of previously visited locations, remain insufficiently addressed. We propose RefBeliefMap, an uncertainty-guided mapping framework that distinguishes target-location belief from spatial and semantic evidence uncertainty. By jointly modeling intra-observation uncertainty and inter-observation disagreement over a sliding memory window, RefBeliefMap assesses the reliability of both evidence channels. When competing frontiers remain insufficiently resolved, these uncertainty estimates guide active observation and semantic reasoning to refine the evidence supporting target-location beliefs before navigation commitment. Building on the refined map, we introduce RefBeliefNav, which jointly evaluates unexplored frontiers and historical waypoints according to their target-finding potential, expected information gain, and navigation cost. This unified objective allows historical locations to be reconsidered as new evidence changes their search value, coordinating exploration and revisitation. Experiments on HM3D and MP3D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines, with ablation studies examining the contributions of modules. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot further demonstrate the sim-to-real transferability of our method.

analysis.key_results: 在 HM3D 和 MP3D 上达到所评估零样本基线中的最先进性能；消融研究验证了各模块贡献；在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上的真实实验证明了仿真到现实的迁移能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 RefBeliefMap 和 RefBeliefNav，分别用于不确定性引导的地图构建和同时评估未探索前沿与历史航点的导航决策，实现探索与回访的协调。
analysis.method: 联合建模观察内不确定性（intra-observation uncertainty）和观察间分歧（inter-observation disagreement），利用滑动记忆窗口评估证据可靠性，并引导主动观察和语义推理精化目标位置信念。

papers.abstract: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

analysis.key_results: ANTE 将 Qwen3-32B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 pass@1 从 25.0% 提升至 57.2%，比无信念状态的 GRPO 基线高 6.2%；世界模型准确率从 44% 升至 69%；学习到的前瞻能力可迁移到其他测试环境和分布外领域。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ANTE 框架，包括 Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) 和 ANTE-TTO，用于训练编码智能体的内部世界模型并提升其决策能力。
analysis.method: BAPO 将智能体动作前的预测与实际执行结果对比，利用验证后的信念为每步动作生成优势估计，并在推理时通过 ANTE-TTO 在无外部评分器的情况下选择候选动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ANTE 框架通过让编码智能体在执行动作前预测结果、再用实际执行验证信念并转化为逐步信用，从而学习可迁移的内部世界模型并提升测试时表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究虽然针对编码智能体的世界模型，但其核心思想——通过动作前预测、执行验证、信念锚定的信用分配来训练可迁移的内部世界模型——在方法论上可为机器人动作-世界模型（WAM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的学习提供借鉴，但并未直接涉及机器人或具身智能任务。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically deployed as isolated single-agent policies. When several such agents share a workspace, they can coordinate implicitly, by observing one another, or explicitly, by exchanging messages, but it remains unclear when explicit communication becomes necessary. We introduce CoLA (Coordination via Learned Adapters), which keeps each agent's VLA backbone frozen and trains a lightweight message channel and a per-arm diffusion action head on top, with fully decentralised execution. Across three tasks that differ in how much each agent can observe, the channel matters only when information is private. On an occluded tray handover, where the box's colour marker is visible to one agent only, CoLA reaches 76.0% success versus 1.3% with messages zeroed throughout training. On two-arm and three-arm handover tasks, removing messages has no measurable effect with a shared overhead camera (90.6% vs. 88.3% at two arms; 63.5% vs. 60.0% at three), but lowers success on the two-arm task's wrist-only variant (74.8% vs. 64.3%). This architecture generalises across different VLA backbones as well. With a frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ backbone on the same occluded tray task, CoLA matches the overall success rate of a LoRA-fine-tuned baseline (37.3% vs. 34.7%) using a fraction of the trainable parameters. When CoLA places the box, it selects the correct tray 71.8% of the time, whereas the independently fine-tuned baseline, whose placing arm never sees the marker, selects it at chance level (34.7% against 33.3%).

analysis.key_results: 在遮挡托盘交接任务中，CoLA成功率达76.0%，而训练时消息置零的变体仅1.3%；双臂和三臂交接任务中，共享俯视相机下移除消息影响不显著（双臂90.6%对88.3%，三臂63.5%对60.0%），但双臂仅腕部相机变体中移除消息成功率从74.8%降至64.3%；在冻结π0.5骨干时CoLA与LoRA微调基线总体成功率相当（37.3%对34.7%），且CoLA正确选择托盘的比例为71.8%，独立微调基线为34.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入CoLA（通过学习适配器协调），在不微调VLA主干的情况下，实现多VLA智能体通过消息通道进行协调，并证明仅在信息私有时需要显式通信。
analysis.method: 冻结VLA骨干网络，训练轻量消息通道和每臂扩散动作头，采用完全去中心化执行；通过对比有无消息通道的变体来研究显式通信的必要性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CoLA方法，通过冻结每个智能体的VLA骨干网络，训练轻量消息通道和每个机械臂的扩散动作头，实现多VLA智能体的隐式与显式协调。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA模型在多智能体协调中的应用，通过冻结VLA主干并添加轻量适配器实现高效通信，属于VLA在机器人操作中的协调方法，与机器人动作预测和多智能体协作密切相关，但未涉及世界模型或WAM。

papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

analysis.key_results: 在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 LongCat-Video-13B 上，TempoKV 在可比或更高压缩比下生成质量优于现有 KV 缓存量化方法，最高达到 6.71 倍 KV 缓存压缩，且质量-效率权衡最佳。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 TempoKV，一种针对自回归视频扩散模型的训练无关预测式 KV 缓存量化方法，通过离线线性回归预测键和值，仅存储残差，实现高压缩比下的高质量生成。
analysis.method: 基于键、值不同依赖关系预测 KV 缓存：键由其历史时序预测，值由当前键和少量历史值预测，仅存储预测残差于低精度，预测器离线用 BF16 样本线性回归校准，推理时固定。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 TempoKV，一种无需训练的预测式 KV 缓存量化框架，利用时序可预测性和键值不对称性，在低精度下仅存储残差，以更少的显存开销实现高质量自回归视频生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于自回归视频生成模型的 KV 缓存量化，属于高效推理技术，未涉及 VLA 或世界模型。该方法可能为视频世界模型的高效推理提供参考，但摘要未明确讨论机器人或世界模型应用。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly predicting future visual states and actions, yet most existing methods make decisions primarily from the current observation. This limits their reliability in long-horizon tasks, where visually similar states may correspond to different interaction histories and task stages. Moreover, directly incorporating historical observations can introduce stale, stage-mismatched, or error-contaminated information, leading to inaccurate world prediction and accumulated closed-loop errors. We propose RM-WAM, a reliable memory-augmented World Action Model that treats memory as a context-dependent predictive resource rather than universally useful historical context. RM-WAM represents history using complementary short-term visual state memory and latent event memory, which respectively capture recent interaction dynamics and longer-term state transitions. A counterfactual memory learning scheme varies the accessible history while keeping the current inputs and prediction targets fixed, enabling the model to learn a context-dependent utility estimate for historical memory. Based on this estimate, a utility-aware gating mechanism adaptively controls memory injection into the world-action backbone. Experiments demonstrate that RM-WAM highlights the importance of reliable and selective memory utilization in long-horizon tasks.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明RM-WAM在长时程任务中凸显了可靠且选择性利用记忆的重要性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RM-WAM，将历史记忆视为上下文相关的预测资源，通过反事实记忆学习评估记忆效用，并利用效用感知门控自适应控制记忆注入。
analysis.method: 结合短期视觉状态记忆和潜在事件记忆，采用反事实记忆学习方案与效用感知门控机制来选择性利用历史信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种可靠记忆增强的世界动作模型，通过上下文相关的记忆效用估计和门控机制，提升长时程机器人操作中世界预测和动作决策的可靠性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接研究世界动作模型（WAM），通过改进记忆机制提升长时程机器人操作中的世界预测和动作生成能力，属于本站核心主题。

papers.abstract: Recently, AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models have emerged as a competitive paradigm for high-quality image synthesis. However, their substantial computational and memory demands make them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides a promising solution to reduce the computational and memory costs of ARVG models, yet existing methods often suffer from substantial image quality degradation under low-bit quantization. In this paper, we propose a training-free PTQ framework for ARVG, consisting of Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR) and Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS). T-BGR introduces a tail-aware reconstruction objective for weight quantizer calibration, assigning greater importance to distribution-tail coefficients and preserving fine-grained information without introducing additional parameters or high-precision branches. CAPS performs coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling by jointly considering the importance and computational cost of different generation stages, enabling efficient mixed-precision allocation under a given bit budget. Extensive experiments on multiple ARVG backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently improves robustness under aggressive low-bit quantization. Notably, on Infinity, our framework achieves near full-precision image generation quality at an effective W4A5.6 activation precision, while existing methods at W4A6 still exhibit noticeable quality degradation or inconsistent performance. Code is available at https://github.com/lxm-lc/HGA-Quant.

analysis.key_results: 在多个ARVG骨干模型上，框架在低位量化下持续提升鲁棒性；在Infinity上，以有效W4A5.6激活精度达到接近全精度的图像生成质量，优于现有W4A6方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出免训练PTQ框架HGA-Quant，包含T-BGR权重校准和CAPS激活精度调度，在不增加参数或高精度分支的情况下提升ARVG模型低位量化的鲁棒性和生成质量。
analysis.method: 训练后量化：T-BGR尾部感知有界初始化网格细化权重校准，CAPS粗细粒度激活精度调度，基于重要性和计算成本进行混合精度分配。

papers.abstract: Evaluating robot manipulation policies through repeated physical trials is costly. We study whether an action-conditioned world model can serve as a closed-loop test environment whose policy success rates track those on real robots. Beyond realistic video, the model must return the camera views and proprioceptive state needed for the policy's next action and preserve failed-action outcomes to avoid overestimating policy capability. We introduce ProWorld, a world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot state, then feeds both back to a frozen policy for repeated interaction. ProWorld comprises a shared transformer for joint video-state flow prediction and Shared-Time View Encoding to distinguish cameras while preserving temporal synchronization. To reduce interaction hallucinations that turn missed grasps into successful lifts, we augment training with failed interactions collected in high-fidelity simulation, reducing inflated success rates in the generated environment. ProWorld achieves the highest overall TriWorldBench score among the compared methods. Across three policies and four local manipulation tasks, it attains a Pearson correlation of 0.95 and a Spearman correlation of 0.94 between generated and real success rates. These results support joint visual-proprioceptive feedback and failure-aware training as a basis for world-model-based policy evaluation.

analysis.key_results: ProWorld 在 TriWorldBench 中取得最高总分；在三个策略和四个局部操作任务上，生成环境与真实成功率之间 Pearson 相关系数为 0.95，Spearman 相关系数为 0.94。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ProWorld 世界模型，利用共享 transformer 进行视频-状态联合流预测和 Shared-Time View Encoding，并引入失败交互增强训练，实现高保真闭环策略评估。
analysis.method: 联合多视角视频与机器人状态预测，将二者反馈给冻结策略；Shared-Time View Encoding 保持时间同步；用仿真中收集的失败交互增强训练以减少幻觉。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出世界模型 ProWorld，通过联合预测多视角视频和机器人状态并反馈给固定策略，在生成环境中评估机器人操作策略的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接研究世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作策略评估中的应用，通过动作条件下的多视角视频和本体感知状态预测支持闭环仿真，对本站 WAM 主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

analysis.key_results: CS-VGB在解析可处理的环境中展示了在验证器误差下恢复目标分布，而其他验证器采样方法失败；在ImageNet、CelebA和多机器人规划中，随着推理预算增加，奖励和任务成功率提高，图像生成奖励超过去噪基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入连续状态验证器引导回溯（CS-VGB），一种从连续生成模型的奖励倾斜分布中采样的推理时扩展方法，在中间验证器不准确时仍能收敛到目标分布。
analysis.method: 通过正确配对的去噪和重噪转移，CS-VGB在干净检查点的平稳分布等于期望的奖励倾斜目标；该方法在扩散模型和一步随机后验映射中实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CS-VGB方法，在连续生成模型中通过反复去噪和重噪实现奖励倾斜分布的推理时采样，即使中间验证器不准确也能收敛到目标分布。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于连续生成模型的推理时扩展（采样效率），属于独立的Speculative Decoding主题，虽在实验包含多机器人规划，但核心贡献不直接涉及VLA或WAM，对本站主题无直接技术关联。

papers.abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) on a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases. The fine-tuned model reaches 95.42% accuracy (95% CI 91.98-97.42%) and a macro F1 of 0.9551, up from 65.00% for the unadapted weights (62.92% through the remote API). However, TF-IDF linear SVM and logistic regression baselines trained on the same split reach 98.75% (95% CI 96.39-99.57%) with sub-millisecond CPU inference, so on this benchmark the fine-tuned model offers no accuracy advantage over a well-tuned linear classifier. A Leave-One-Symptom-Out clause-ablation analysis of four illustrative narratives shows predictions depending on distinguishing clauses: in a psoriasis example, removing the clause describing silvery scales lowers the predicted probability from above 99.99% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo, while removing other clauses changes it by less than 0.001 percentage points. Decision architectures deliver structured, single-pass predictions from large language backbones, but short, lexically distinctive benchmarks such as Symptom2Disease cannot show an advantage over simple baselines; validation on longer, real clinical text and clinician review are needed.

analysis.key_results: 微调模型准确率达95.42%，宏观F1为0.9551；TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线准确率达98.75%；消融分析显示预测强烈依赖于区分性症状描述。
analysis.limitations: 在短、词汇特征明显的基准数据集上，微调模型无法超越简单基线；需要在更长、真实的临床文本上验证并经临床医生审查。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了在Symptom2Disease基准上，经过4-bit QLoRA微调的90亿参数决策模型虽然大幅提升了准确率，但与简单的TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线相比没有优势。
analysis.method: 使用QLoRA（4-bit量化的低秩适应）对基于Qwen3.5的Clef-Flash决策模型进行微调，并与TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线进行比较，还进行了Leave-One-Symptom-Out消融分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究微调了一个90亿参数的决策基础模型用于症状到疾病分类，并将其与简单的TF-IDF线性基线进行对比，结果显示微调模型在准确率上并不占优。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究的是语言模型量化微调在文本分类任务上的效果，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）没有直接关系，但量化方法可作为参考。

papers.abstract: Due to the high cost of hardware experiments, robot policies are predominantly evaluated by comparing their empirical performance on a limited number of hardware trials. However, finite-sample statistical uncertainty can lead to erroneous conclusions, especially when ranking multiple policies using a fixed batch of evaluation data. We propose AnyRank: a sequential method for multi-policy ranking that (i) adaptively allocates trials to hard-to-separate policies, (ii) provides (partial) rankings at any stopping time while bounding the probability of an incorrect ranking, and (iii) optionally exploits prior information to prioritize hardware evaluations more efficiently. This prior information could be informed from expert intuition, a small set of held-out hardware evaluations, or from policy rollouts in a simulator or an action-conditioned video world model. Notably, the prior can be imperfect; while a strong prior can provide efficiency gains on hardware, any inaccuracies in prior policy rankings do not invalidate the statistical assurances of AnyRank. We achieve the aforementioned properties through novel theoretical contributions that combine sequential testing with multiple-hypothesis graphical testing approaches. Experiments in simulation and real-world policy evaluation benchmarks show that AnyRank requires up to 50% fewer hardware evaluations compared to existing statistically rigorous approaches, while guarding against the incorrect rankings produced by heuristic methods used by state-of-the-art benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界政策评估基准中，AnyRank相比现有统计严格方法所需硬件评估次数减少高达50%，同时规避了启发式方法的错误排名。
analysis.main_contribution: AnyRank是一种基于序贯检验和多重假设图检验的多策略排名方法，具有自适应试验分配、随时提供部分排名且错误概率有界、可利用可能不完美的先验信息等特性。
analysis.method: 结合序贯检验与多重假设图形化检验，实现自适应试验分配，并可融合专家直觉、少量硬件评估、模拟器或动作条件视频世界模型中的先验信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种序贯多策略排名方法AnyRank，在保证排名错误概率有界的同时，自适应分配硬件试验并利用先验信息减少评估成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: AnyRank可用于高效评估机器人策略排名，其先验信息来源可包括动作条件视频世界模型或模拟器，因此与VLA（机器人策略评估）以及世界模型（作为先验信息提供者）直接相关。虽然本文重点在于策略评估方法而非策略学习本身，但能有效减少硬件试验次数，对机器人学习领域的可靠评估具有重要意义。

figures.caption: Reliable Policy Ranking with AnyRank . Prior information is leveraged to form a weighted multi-hypothesis graph, which in turn informs an active evaluation protocol to minimize expected sample complexity. The resulting ranking provably maintains a pre-specified error rate.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: AnyRank: Reliable Anytime Policy Ranking via Sequential Testing
papers.title_zh: AnyRank：通过序贯检验实现可靠的多策略随时排名

papers.abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $\pi_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.

analysis.key_results: 在101个扫描校园环境（中位可导航面积104.87平方米、7个容器）中生成852个容器和超过68,000个抓取演示；最强个性化策略在目标场景达到62.5%的整体抓取成功率；在真实Stretch 3机器人上12项任务子集达到63.9%成功率，仿真对应66.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Splat2Act，一个自动化的real-to-sim-to-real流水线，将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略个性化到特定场景和物体集合，仅需手持手机扫描和用户物体的图像。
analysis.method: 利用3D高斯泼溅构建逼真数字孪生，自动发现桌面和非桌面容器，构建可行的抓取任务，并使用特权仿真预言机生成成功演示，随后通过两阶段微调个性化预训练VLA策略（π0.5）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Splat2Act提出一种自动化的真实到仿真到真实流程，仅用手机扫描和物体图像即可将预训练VLA策略个性化到特定场景和物体，实现物体抓取。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作在VLA策略个性化领域具有核心价值：专注于从真实场景扫描到仿真再到真实的自动化流程，用于微调预训练VLA策略（π0.5），实现机器人抓取操作。它直接涉及VLA策略学习、仿真到真实迁移和机器人操作，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: The end-to-end pipeline of Splat2Act. Scene captures are reconstructed as a 3DGS with a mesh collision geometry, while simulation-ready 3D assets are generated from object captures. Receptacle discovery and reachability-aware task planning construct feasible pickup tasks, and a privileged oracle generates demonstrations for broad Stage 1 adaptation and Stage 2 personalization before real-world deployment.

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.title_zh: Splat2Act：从捕获场景到个性化VLA操作

papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models encode broad manipulation priors, yet adapting them to specific tasks requires balancing limited robot interaction, computational resources, and safety constraints. Noise space learning (NSL) adapts flow-matching-based VLAs by learning a context-conditioned distribution over noise while keeping the pretrained VLA fixed. Building on prior noise-steering methods, we formulate NSL as an interface for VLA adaptation that accommodates different learning algorithms and instantiate it with PPO, SAC, and AWR. Theoretically, we provide an information-theoretic analysis of how NSL enables efficient adaptation. Empirically, we study these NSL algorithms on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot manipulation tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints. Across these settings, we develop a suite of effective NSL variants and derive practical recommendations for choosing among them under different resource and deployment regimes.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin和四个真实机器人操作任务上，开发了有效的NSL变体，并给出在不同资源和部署约束下的实用建议。
analysis.main_contribution: 将NSL形式化为一个适用于不同学习算法(PPO、SAC、AWR)的VLA适应接口，并提供信息论分析以及跨基准和真实机器人的实证研究。
analysis.method: 噪声空间学习(NSL)：保持预训练流匹配VLA固定，学习上下文条件下的噪声分布，并用PPO、SAC、AWR实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出噪声空间学习(NSL)作为一种通用接口，在冻结预训练流匹配VLA的情况下，通过学习上下文条件噪声分布实现高效适应。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA模型的适应方法，旨在在有限交互、计算和安全约束下高效适配预训练VLA，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Different VLA adaptation approaches for a deterministic generator. NSL learns a context-conditioned noise distribution, generator adaptation updates the noise-to-action map, and residual adaptation modifies generated actions before execution. Orange modules are trainable; blue modules are fixed.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Noise Space Learning for VLA Adaptation
papers.title_zh: 噪声空间学习用于VLA适应

papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

analysis.key_results: 代码修复成功率从26.3%提升到31.2%；GUI任务完成率提高且平均动作减少39.4%；实验室规划得分从21.80%提高到46.01%；反应优化平均最佳观测产率达96.15%（对比贝叶斯优化的82.16%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RSI-Anything框架，基于JEPA-Anything的预测世界模型，通过动作选择、学习数据选择以及条件世界模型自适应实现递归自我改进。
analysis.method: 使用预测世界模型指导动作和学习数据选择，观察反馈驱动策略或工作流改进，并进行条件世界模型自适应，通过组件和兼容性检查管理策略-模型对的保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RSI-Anything框架利用预测世界模型指导动作和学习数据选择，在多个计算与科学领域实现递归自我改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于预测世界模型与策略的递归改进，属于世界模型和策略学习范畴，但未明确针对机器人操作或VLA。其方法论对世界模型驱动的策略改进有参考价值，但与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

Building on the cross-domain predictive foundation of JEPA-Anything, RSI-Anything uses world-model predictions to support understanding, planning, and action selection across diverse tasks. Interaction feedback drives policy or workflow updates and conditional world-model adaptation. Component and compatibility checks determine which policy–model pair is retained to guide the next round of interaction and learning, closing the recursive self-improvement loop.

Only the executed candidate (B) yields paired prediction–observation feedback. Feedback supports policy or workflow revision and reliability assessment; world-model adaptation depends on prediction reliability, available data, and budget. papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models

papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $\pi_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $\pi_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

analysis.key_results: 在CALVIN上，D2R在想象中连续改进八个任务，平均成功率从63.7%提升至74.8%，而LoRA微调降至11.7%；使用π0和A2World时，D2R在LIBERO-90上学习未见任务并保持已有性能；真实Franka机器人上连续改进三个任务并保持早期改进。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出D2R方法，在持续学习新任务时，通过世界模型想象回溯来保留早期技能，无需回放缓冲区或新数据。
analysis.method: 利用冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象回放来锚定引导模块的旧行为，从而持续引导冻结的通用策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该方法通过持续引导冻结的通用机器人策略来学习新任务，同时利用预训练世界模型进行想象回溯以保留先前技能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接利用世界模型支持通用机器人策略的持续学习，与VLA和世界模型密切相关。

papers.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
papers.title_zh: 记忆之梦：基于世界模型的通用机器人策略持续引导

papers.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

analysis.key_results: 在服务批大小256下，标准解码加速1.20-1.47倍；在两个120B级模型上，吞吐量约为vLLM投机解码的1.8倍；分离状态精度降低了输出KL散度和下游精度损失。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReplaySSM，通过展开递归将SSM状态表示为检查点和最近输入缓冲，从而减少状态写入、支持低成本投机回滚和输出专用验证。
analysis.method: 定期更新检查点，避免大部分步骤的状态写入；利用输入缓冲进行投机回滚和仅输出验证；分离低精度输出计算检查点与高精度递归更新检查点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ReplaySSM通过分离状态检查点更新与输出计算，减少SSM推理中的状态I/O并支持低开销投机回滚。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于SSM的高效推理和投机解码，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但对采用SSM架构的VLA/WAM模型的推理优化具有直接的效率提升价值。

papers.abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama和Qwen模型上，于WikiText-2、C4及零样本下游任务中，DUALQUANT在多数模型和格式上匹配或超过基于校准的SmoothQuant，显著优于免校准基线；在RTX 4090上实现Llama-3.1-8B的W4A4推理，记忆减少最高2.61倍，吞吐量提升最高2.46倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DUALQUANT，一种双尺度、免校准的训练后量化框架，直接最小化权重重构MSE，并得到逐通道激活缩放，支持包括MX系列和NVFP4在内的多种格式。
analysis.method: 将问题形式化为不可微权重重构问题，采用变量分裂和块坐标下降的高效求解器，每个子问题有闭式解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种免校准的双尺度训练后量化框架，通过最小化权重重构误差同时获得激活缩放因子，支持MX和NVFP4等格式。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于LLM的低比特量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型。但其提出的免校准激活量化技术可迁移到VLA模型的高效推理，具有一定的间接价值。

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.

analysis.key_results: 在400个LIBERO回合中成功率达95.5%，每16步动作块推理耗时57ms、计算量2.3 TFLOP、GPU显存2.4 GiB；比教师模型快11倍，FLOPs减少18.5倍，显存减少3.2倍，且世界头仍能预测场景运动。
analysis.main_contribution: 从2B参数的Cosmos Policy提炼出隐式世界-动作模型SmolWAM，保留预训练主干并重建推理接口，在边缘设备上实现高效动作与未来视觉潜变量预测。
analysis.method: 保留预训练主干，采用单帧视觉潜变量、缓存注意力沉没的文本特征、28个Transformer块中的12个，以及1008个token，单步整流流读出击动作和未来视觉潜变量；训练耗时3.6 GPU小时。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SmolWAM，一种通过精简Cosmos Policy模型而得到的隐式世界-动作模型，可在边缘设备上高效预测机器人动作与未来视觉状态。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接属于世界-动作模型（WAM）研究方向，聚焦于将WAM部署到资源受限的边缘设备，通过模型精简和高效推理实现机器人操作策略。
